items.desc: The old Roman Empire survived centered around …, although they followed … instead of the proper … faith of …. As such, it is our sacred duty to supplant them as Eastern Rome, establishing a … Emperor in ….

adv.d: With the Frankokratia united under our rule, our court now meticulously blends the rigid, martial feudal hierarchies of the French and Occitan tradition with the ancient, intricate ceremonies of the Greeks. By adopting the purple robes and the dignity of the East, we command the spiritual respect of our Greek subjects while maintaining the chivalric loyalty of our Western knights. This synthesis transforms the Emperor from a mere foreign conqueror into a legitimate successor of Constantine, recognized by the Pope and feared by our enemies.

Dominating the narrow gates of the Black Sea allows us to levy heavy tolls on the Italian merchant republics that once dictated our fate through debt and naval blockade. The wealth of the Pontic grain trade and the Silk Road's northern terminus now flows directly into the Imperial coffers rather than Venice or Genoa, funding our restoration. We have turned the Golden Horn from a den of foreign merchants into the beating heart of a centralized, sovereign economic powerhouse.

Evolving from the old Varangian tradition, our modern guard consists of professional Catholic mercenaries from across Europe, primarily French veterans and Swiss pikemen. These men are bound to the Emperor not by land or title, but by gold and a shared Crusader identity, serving as an iron fist against disloyal feudal barons. This standing force ensures that the Emperor's will is absolute, providing a stable core for the army that is immune to the whims of the high nobility.

The Latin Emperors have moved beyond feudal levies and now rely on a sophisticated system of maritime tariffs and transit duties. Every ship passing through the Dardanelles or the Bosporus must stop at the Imperial Customs House, where the 'Tenth of the Emperor' is collected in hard coin. This massive revenue stream allows the Empire to maintain a professional, standing army that does not rely on the whims of the nobility.

The Emperor has ordered the complete overhaul of the legal system, merging the Justinian Code with the Frankish-style Assizes of Romania into a single, unified legal body. This Codex Latinus removes the legal distinctions between Frankish and Greek subjects, creating a single class of Imperial Citizens under the Emperor's law. This legal unification is the final nail in the coffin of the old feudal order, paving the way for a truly centralized, absolute monarchy.

adv.n: The Order of the Star of the East
adv.d: The Emperor has established a high-tier order of merit that replaces hereditary titles with service-based nobility, ensuring that the Empire's leaders are chosen for their talent. Membership in the Order is the highest honor in the land, granted to generals, diplomats, and scholars who have expanded the glory of the Latin Throne. This system creates a loyalist elite that is entirely dependent on the Emperor's favor, cementing the monarch's control over the state.

items.name: Deccan

pot.t: Any primary, accepted or tolerated culture:

items.desc: This land was once foreign to our ancestors, but we have made it our own. Here we have built a new society where Persian influences have met local ancient Indian traditions. We have our own language, our own administrative traditions and our own myths and legends. It is time we show the world that the South has overcome its differences and is united as one.

items.name: Delhi
items.desc: Delhi was once the capital of the entire Indian subcontinent, and our own modern state is in many ways a continuation of their traditions. The time of our resurgence has finally come. Let us reclaim the heritage of the sultans of Delhi, and rule the subcontinent from their ancient capital in the Doab!

adv.d: Persian has been the dominant language of the court ever since the first inception of the Dehlavi Sultanate. As such, the influence of Persian has synthesized with local Indian cultures.

The Hindustani language developed from Apabhramsa — a Middle Indo-Aryan language — and emerged as the contact language of Delhi. As Hindustani has influences from Persian, Arabic, and Turkic but also Old Hindi, diplomacy with the Muslim world and the Hindu world becomes an uncomplicated task.

Although we call India our home, the ancestors of our state were of Turkic origins. Their early successes as conquerors and rulers from the days of the Mamlūk dynasty, as well as the achievements of the following Khalji dynasty, inspire our military and diplomats alike to push the borders of Delhi into every corner of India.

The once vast Dehlavi Sultanate has lost most of its former possessions, but we have not forgotten the means of administering them. As we work towards restoring our past glory, we will remind local rulers of their duties to the Sultan.
The Dehlavi Sultanate once encompassed nearly all of India. It must rise again!
The foolish economic decisions of Ghiyath al-Din have brought nothing but financial ruin to the state of Delhi. We must revert his madness and restore the usage of gold and silver for our coins.

Much of the Dehlavi nobility is drawn from the ranks of the Afghan community, a people with a long history of conquest and rule in northern India. Though at times a political hindrance, their martial skills are beyond question.

The thriving textile industry in Delhi makes our nation a hotspot for related technological innovations. As early adopters of the cotton gin and worm gear roller, we know the importance of staying ahead of the curve in these matters. We must now ensure that the spinning wheel is adopted as widely as possible.

India is a massive subcontinent with several religions present. In order to ensure stability within our realm, we should expand the rights of the different faiths, and secure the loyalty of their worshippers.

The Grand Trunk Road runs from Kābul in Afghanistan to the coast of Bengal. Many of the most important trading cities along its route are part of our empire, and so it falls to us to ensure that the road is well maintained and free of banditry.
For centuries, every great Indian empire has been ruled from Delhi. It is the seat of conquerors and our birthright. All must know that Delhi is once again home to the rightful ruler of all India!

During the height of the tughlaq dynasty and the most stable period of our state, great architects and artists of grand vision constructed mosques and tombs in the unique Tughlaq style. As the decades went on and our power was challenged by internal issues, the resources for maintaining this architecture faded. It is time to revive it, and re-establish Delhi as an empire of art and wonders.

Foreign ideas of nationalism and cultural identity have reached India. While the cultural diversity of India will remain high, it is clear that our geography, as well as the values of Islam, give us all a sense of unity in the form of a Hindustani identity.

items.name: Egypt
items.desc: While the history of Egypt is beyond ancient, it was for vast stretches of time ruled by foreign invaders, not its native souls. Forging a new Egyptian state free from outside interference could restore our legendary Empire, much as the Nile overflows and replenishes the land along its banks.

items.name: Ethiopia
items.desc: The ancient empire of Ethiopia was the spiritual successor to the Aksumite Empire, the legendary home of King Solomon's son, and a stalwart bulwark of the Coptic faith. The fall of that Empire was a tragedy for the Coptic faithful, but the spirit of a unified Ethiopia still lives on, waiting to be revived by a worthy successor — like us!

adv.d: We are the only nation to house the sacred Ark of the Covenant after it was secretly taken by Menelik I with divine assistance thousands of years ago. It is hidden away from public view, lest someone attempt to steal our sacred national treasure. Replicas of the Ark are placed in every single one of our churches as a reminder that our rule is blessed by God.

Our people have inhabited the highlands for generations, enduring extreme conditions that have made us resilient and strong. This gives us a significant advantage over our enemies whenever we engage in conflict.
The Ç̌äwa serve as Ethiopia's noble feudal warriors, recruited and appointed for the Emperor's army service. They are a professional soldier class, renowned for their ferocity.

Our ruler is the king of all kings; the heir to the pedigree of the kings of Aksum along with that of the first ruler, Menelik I, the son of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. All of our kings are descended from the Solomon dynasty, and the line of inheritance need not be from father to son.

Our rulers' forefathers are descended from the monarchs of Aksum; from the bloodlines of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. We have deposed the Zagwe monarchs in order to legitimize our rule and firmly establish the kingdom being restored to its rightful dynasty.
A better structure system allows the Ç̌äwa to be better trained and become a mighty force for Ethiopia.

For centuries, our nation has lacked a permanent capital, with the court following the rulers wherever they desired. While this approach has its advantages, in order to effectively govern our vast nation we need to establish a strong central authority in a proper permanent location.
Our envoys to Rome and Iberia, looking for military support, were quite successful — in fact, they put us on the map. These endeavors to find allies should continue.
The introduction of gunpowder makes the traditional bows and javelins obsolete, but gives a new edge to the Ç̌äwa.
As a Christian nation, we find ourselves surrounded by Muslim adversaries who seize every opportunity to attack us. To ensure our survival, we must be prepared to fight back immediately.

People from Europe have been looking for Prester John for centuries, and are convinced that our ruler has to be him, somehow, as we are fellow Christian worshippers. There is no reason to point out that they are wrong, however, as they are now happy to share their ideas with us.
The discipline of the Ç̌äwa Regiments gets further improved, making them fight more coordinated, inflicting deadly volleys to their enemies.
External influences have their uses, but exposure to them can alter the nature of our beliefs. In order to maintain our identity, we must secure the domestic primacy of our own Tewahedo Church.
Our region is diverse in cultures and religions, and the only thing that keeps it united is not compassion, but a powerful ruler, capable of dealing swiftly and decisively with any attempt at revolt.

The Ç̌äwa adapt a line formation, marching side by side and firing in order. When the first line in combat reloads their firearms, the second takes their position to fire, just to be replaced by the next one in a continuous motion.

Despite our apparent isolation, we are well aware of the innovations happening around the world, and we waste no time in implementing these modernizations in order to maintain a competitive advantage over our rivals.

It is from our lands that Coffee comes, as we have the perfect growing conditions. While it can be cultivated in other places, ours is revered for its quality and exported by the ton. We have to make this a way to channel wealth into our nation.
The most modern version of the Ç̌äwa. These fighters have reached the highest point in discipline and effectivity, becoming the terror of their enemies.

items.name: France
items.desc: This year will mark the beginning of an evolutionary period for our nation. The old feudal ways must make way for a more modern, centralized state.

adv.d: The aristocrats of our nation have always provided the best soldiers for our armies. Their well-trained fighters will serve our nation and defeat our enemies in the name of righteous glory!

Our diplomatic maneuvers are renowned for their complexity and finesse, and our skilled envoys emulated across the continent. Yet only a fool would become complacent now — we could further refine our diplomacy through measures such as cultivating networks of informants and perfecting the art of negotiation. Let other nations muddle through yesterday's techniques while we pioneer tomorrow's.

For a long time, Latin has been the language of cultural exchange in Europe... but to be honest, that language is nearly as dead as the ancient Romans who spoke it. We need to find a new lingua franca, and nothing says 'lingua franca' like French.
Cultivating the doctrine of attack is the hallmark of our army. Our men must fight with élan — spirit and vigor — giving us a clear edge on the battlefield.
Our influence over other states is undeniable. Why not use this persuasive power to incorporate them directly into our country?

According to some, the Estates-General have existed since 1303. Over time, its form has shifted from being a council of royalty appointees to one of elected representatives. This change in structure has given the Estates-General, and the taxes levied by them, greater legitimacy.

Reliance on a levy system has exposed our government to great risks, and has proved to be severely limiting. We should recruit heavily armed cavalrymen and pay them a fixed salary in order to create a standing army.

The intendants responsible for collecting the taxes of the people shall not be appointed by the estates, but by our ruler directly. This way, we will ensure these officers will be loyal to the ruler alone, and gather all of the rightful tribute owed.

As a nation much enriched by the Renaissance, we should invest in the creation of a unique, distinctively French aesthetic. By inviting foreign artists to our realm and sponsoring a school for artist training directly, we will be able to brand any artistic works produced as identifiably French.

Direct competition with other maritime powers could be detrimental to our finances. We should empower our mercantile fleet to plunder and seize the merchant ships of our enemies. This will not only ensure a healthy income for our state, but also disrupt the maritime economies of our rivals.

We trace our nation's lineage back to the empire of Charlemagne, and can therefore claim all those lands to be part of our rightful territory. With the support of dedicated courts, we will be able to identify and re-claim all of this long territory.

Our genius in fortification does not represent a radical departure in their design; rather, the innovation comes from the placement of the fortresses. By taking maximum advantage of local terrain, even the most basic fort requires more effort and supplies to take.

We are proud to be the home of so many of the most renowned philosophers of these enlightened times. These thinkers produce a constant stream of groundbreaking ideas, which are stimulating advances in all fields, from the most trifling to the most vital.

We must replace the chaotic patchwork of laws governing our state with a single, unified legal code that applies to our entire population. This Code Civil will serve as the foundation of our government and establish a just system for everyone in our realm.

When measured against our adversaries, our need for military reform becomes painfully apparent. By introducing modern drilling techniques, we can transform our troops into a disciplined force capable of destroying any foe in combat.
With all men declared to be equal under our new laws, adherents of other beliefs are finally allowed full participation in our government, and may thus now contribute to our national progress.

items.name: Great Britain

c.t: We must either destroy … or make them our …!
We must either destroy … or make them our …!
We must either destroy … or make them our …!
We must either destroy … or make them our …!

items.desc: By uniting our political development domestically and extending our influence beyond our borders, we will be able to reinforce our position in world affairs and transform into one of the foremost European powers, the British Empire.

adv.d: The powerful martial longbow, originally deployed with great impact against armored English knights in the Welsh valleys, has been adopted into the military doctrine on either side of the border.

c.t: Is or was the country Wales (WLS)
Is or was the country England (ENG)
Is or was the country Great Britain (GBR)

adv.d: The Longbowmen excel not only due to their powerful warbow but also their years of training on the archery fields.

Beginning around 1495, the Tudor monarchy invested heavily in not just ships, but extensive infrastructure to maintain and otherwise support them. This for many marked the official founding of the Royal Navy.

c.t: Is or was the country Wales (WLS)
Is or was the country England (ENG)
Is or was the country Great Britain (GBR)

adv.d: Small innovations in equipment and organization result in continuous devastating volleys that shatter all but the most heavily armored formations.

c.t: Is or was the country Scotland (SCO)
Is or was the country Great Britain (GBR)
Is or was the country Isles (LOI)

adv.d: Since the Wars of Independence, we have been looking at reinforcing and updating our navy. Previously, we had used feudal obligations to bulk out our fleets with crew and ships, but we will now create a modern fleet, owned by the King and based in our port of Newhaven.

The monarch has always had a secretary responsible for their royal correspondence. This position eventually evolved into that of the Secretary of State, a powerful minister who not only transmits royal decrees, but also has a high level of administrative authority.

c.t: Is or was the country Scotland (SCO)
Is or was the country Great Britain (GBR)

adv.d: If Scotland is to continue its independent existence, we must secure stable sources of income. By tightening our control over the obligations owed to us by royal estates and feudal properties, we can increase our rightfully received taxes. Through these methods, we can ensure the Crown has sufficient funds to enact their will without relying on other sources of money.

The Eltham Ordinances represented England's first attempt to streamline royal bureaucracy and make it more adaptable and cost-effective. The Ordinances attempted reform through reducing royal household expenditures and consolidating certain bureaucratic functions.

c.t: Is or was the country Scotland (SCO)
Is or was the country Great Britain (GBR)

adv.d: It has long been the custom to gift parts of the Royal Domain to our nobility as a reward for their services, but this system cannot be sustained if we want to ensure the integrity of our domain. From now on, we will insist on renting these lands instead of outright giving them away.

Robert Blake has written several sets of rules and regulations that resulted in sweeping naval reforms. These include new tactics for blockades and landings, as well as adoption of the single line ahead battle formation.

The invention of coke smelting, specifically its application in Iron and Steel production, is closely tied to the Industrial Revolution. Iron and Steel are currently produced using traditional methods like charcoal smelting, whereas this new method will result in improved output and reduced maintenance costs.

A sweeping series of reforms limiting royal power, particularly in judicial matters. Among other stipulations, they state that the monarch may not unilaterally raise armies, prescribe cruel and unusual punishment, or interfere with the free election of members of Parliament.

The architectural innovations made by Inigo Jones will undoubtedly have a significant impact on future generations of architects. His promotion of classical architecture and his priority on proportion and harmony are considered hallmarks of the neoclassical movement in England.
These acts represent the apex of mercantilism. Trade must be conducted with our ships and pass through our ports first, where we will collect customs duties and any other applicable taxes.
This institution looked after the welfare of ordinary enlisted seamen in the Navy. It brought about a series of reforms that greatly improved the health of sailors on duty.

Elite marksmen equipped with the long-range Baker Rifle and trained to screen the main force in small independent pickets, Experimental Riflemen represent a modern vision of infantry combat formations.

Life in the English army is grueling and strictly regimented, but it instills in one a certain character. The unflappable nature of our troops, as well as their expertise with firearms, strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies.
A massive sea presence is required for any nation attempting to rule the waters. Our fleet will be so imposing that the shores of our enemies will always be surrounded by our vessels.
The water frame is a spinning frame used in the textile industry to produce cotton thread. This innovation will contribute to the establishment of large textile factories powered by water wheels.

items.name: Gujarat
items.desc: … has always had an identity distinct from the rest of India, and … people are proud of their ancient history and unique identity. We long for a nation of our own, where we may rule by these idiosyncratic principles. Luckily for us, it seems the moment to seize our independence is quickly approaching…

items.name: Haudenosaunee
items.desc: The tribes of the … have long coexisted in a formal confederation, although each nation within the tribe retained its own autonomy. But times have changed, and we have made the strategic decision to make our current ties even stronger. With the five nations now led by a central tribe, we can push forward as a newly strengthened confederacy.

items.name: Hungary
items.desc: The old Kingdom of Hungary was once the ultimate power in …, controlling the region for centuries. But even the strongest walls cannot stand forever, and the old state eventually fell apart, thanks to invasion and expansions by our rivals. Yet we have arrived at the precipice of greatness, and the time to resurrect the fallen Hungary is finally at hand. Let us rise to the great imperial heights we deserve to reach!

adv.d: The Castle Warriors, one of the most select classes in our society, are duty-bound to provide military service to their local ispáns in royal castle districts. Stalwarts from the earliest days of our nation, these privileged landholders hold a unique position, actively defending their realm while cherishing their hereditary rights.

The peasants consider their ruler a just one because they are officially protected from having excessive demands and other abuses heaped upon them by magnates. The ruler of Hungary is a true Renaissance prince — a successful military leader and administrator, an outstanding linguist, and an enlightened patron of the arts.

Inspired by the writings of Julius Caesar, Hungary shall maintain a corps of professional soldiers. These warriors will be so fierce that our enemies shall whisper terrified tales of 'The Black Army' to their children at night!
With Turkish power rising in the south, it falls to the people of Hungary to defend faithful kingdoms from the Turkish threat. Let it be known that we will not flinch from our sacred duty!

Hungary is not blessed with protective natural frontiers. The wild plains that first brought our ancestors here were perfect for launching raids into the West, not for defense. If Hungary is to defend itself, we will need resources. The best solution is to allow our magnates to bind the peasants more closely to the land, ensuring greater productivity.

Although our subjects have faced many external threats over the years, the spirit and will of the Hungarian people remains unbroken. Unifying Hungarian hearts is greatly inspiring to our patriotic soldiers, who will defend our homelands to the last man.

items.name: Inca

c.t: Has government reform: Reformed Tawantinsuyu Government

items.desc: The Altiplano is divided among many nations, each inhabiting the valleys and worshiping different gods. We are a people who speak many tongues and have diverse perspectives, yet together we represent a cultural and spiritual force few other nations could stand against. We shall bring all our scattered territories together to follow one strong leader. The sun shall cast its light over a unified realm!

adv.d: The chasquis are the messengers of our state. Chosen from the fittest and most durable runners of our country, these agile men carry Quipu strings, messages, gifts, and other kinds of information, and deliver them to the target recipient. The spread of ideas, as well as the bulk of our diplomacy, rests on their shoulders.

Our road system is one of our empire's most valuable assets. To further benefit our military and administration, we will erect tambo way stations along all the main roads. These stations will be built within a day's march of each other, and will provide shelter and carry supplies for travelers.

The mit'a is a mandatory public service system fundamental to Incan society, and forms the backbone of the military service. Every ayllu must contribute capable men, adapted to combat in the highlands, to provide labor for state projects and military service.

In order to undertake great building projects in the past, our rulers had to fulfill ancient traditions by inviting every single petty chief in our empire to the capital, showering them with gifts, and holding lavish feasts. As our state grows, however, this is far from an ideal way to undertake these projects. Supplying labor and materials for construction should be the duty of each and every chief in our lands.

c.t: Is or was the country Inca (INC)
Is or was the country Qusqu (CSU)

adv.d: The Tambo is a supply depot of the Incas. The purpose of the Tambo varies significantly depending on the size of the structure. Smaller tambos serve as road stops for passing travelers while larger ones can even serve as an office for the province's administration.

No other empire is as well adapted to the heights of the Andes as we are. By maintaining settlements and storehouses at every altitude, from the lowest valleys to the highest plateaus, we have mastered the method of moving men and goods across the most difficult terrain, where other states would falter. Our llama caravans, our roads carved into sheer cliffsides, and our highland communities turn the Andes from a barrier into our own highway.

The warachikuy is a holy ceremony where young men are tested in their skills, valor, and wits, as well as their physical abilities like racing, marksmanship, combat, and durability for extended lengths of sleep deprivation. Those who pass these tests with excellence are promoted to the rank of officers for our ever-growing army.

Llamas have many functions in our society. They act as beasts of burden, as sacrifices, provide meat and wool, and even give us fertilizer for our crops with their dung. Controlling the breeding and use of llamas through government michis, or herders, we ensure that the llama population is strictly monitored. This will provide an opportunity for the llama population to increase

A system which uses knots on a string to store information, do accounting, and perform other informational tasks. Each knot represents a number from zero to nine. The knots can also be used to refer to logograms on the same string. The knots show which syllable in the logogram to use, and by combining more strings, sentences can be formed.

The Hatun Runas are the peasant class of our empire. One in fifty men are chosen for military service on their twenty-fifth birthdays, and conscripted for the next seven years. This conscription system helps us maintain a substantial professional army with superior discipline than the troops of our adversaries.

Invaders from strange lands have set foot in our territory, and threaten our very existence. But our armies are adaptive; they adjust to new enemy tactics, learn to wield their very own weapons against them, and fight with an unbreakable resolve inspired by their foes.

items.name: Jerusalem

c.t: War Score vs other Religion Efficiency: -25%

items.desc: Jerusalem is the promised land, a sacred city that people of many faiths look to as the birthplace of their beliefs. Thus, a Kingdom of Heaven shall be proclaimed over this holy land. Let all who worship be amazed at our splendor!

b: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle: +20%
adv.d: We stand on the frontlines of Christendom, surrounded by unbelief. It is our sacred duty to shield the Holy City and strike fear into the hearts of heathens who would dare usurp it.

Jerusalem is the holiest city in Christendom, the very place of Christ's Passion and Resurrection. By asserting Catholic supremacy over these sacred grounds, we become the spiritual beacon of the Latin world and a pillar of the true faith.

In the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, the ancient Latin rites are once more performed in full splendor. These solemn rituals, honoring the death and resurrection of Christ, reinforce our divine mandate to rule this land and spread the teachings of our faith.

Rome has reinstated the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, once exiled and forgotten. Now restored, the Patriarch shall strengthen our influence in Rome and reinforce our role as guardian of the Church's interests in the East.

Our realm is a crucible of noble blood from around Europe, zealous pilgrims, and old Levantine stock. Through careful governance, we shall weave together this diverse heritage into a Latin Christian society, where faith and culture go hand in hand.

items.name: Kongo
items.desc: The … people are a branch of the …. Although great diversity exists among our people, we also have many commonalities in our daily spiritual and cultural practices. If we connect along these shared characteristics and agree to be a united nation rather than an assortment of individual settlements, the …-speaking peoples will be able to achieve more than ever before.

adv.d: Before the rise of our realm, the people of this region governed themselves through clan councils and provincial alliances. What we now call Kongo emerged from centuries of interwoven relationships, where loyalty to the land and kin outweighed loyalty to borders. Uniting this patchwork into a centralized realm was no small feat, but we did it and we will keep it together yet.

The strangers came from the sea with beards, books, and barrels of wine. They brought with them strange gods, stranger languages, and an entire ocean of opportunity. Our emissaries have learned their customs, their intentions, and — most importantly — how to turn their need for allies into our advantage.

All things must begin somewhere, and for our kingdom, that beginning lies with Lukeni lua Nimi. He was more than a conqueror. Indeed, he was a founder, the father of our realm. His bloodline commanded respect, not just for its ancestry, but because it reminds the people who first dared to dream of a unified Kongo.

The influx of foreigners and cultural exchanges have made an impact on our society. However, we have not abandoned our own ways. We call upon deities by Kikongo names, we proudly wear our religious insignia, and our ceremonies echo with both drums and hymns. This is a vibrant example of our clarity, and the gods seem to agree.

The musket may not make a man brave, but it certainly makes him fearsome. Let those in Europe boast of their superiority; we will buy their weapons, master their drills, and soon enough the only thing distinguishing our soldiers from theirs will be the color of their flags.
Prisoners and laborers are needed overseas to operate our many worksites, plantations, and mines. While this is far from a noble endeavor, none can deny the profitable nature of these exploits.

items.name: Kurdistan
items.desc: The … people have always lived in autonomous tribes, without a central unifying figure to lead them. But if we were to establish a … nation, and to bring our scattered groups together as one, we could easily become the authoritative power in the region.

adv.d: Our people have established several great dynasties, ruling territories from Egypt to Iran. Tying our own state to the glory of past rulers will allow us to be a unifying symbol for the Kurdish people, and make our rule seem more legitimate in the eyes of our subjects.
Having asserted our authority over all Kurdish tribes, we will be able to call upon their experienced, hardened warriors to defend our country.

Our homelands are surrounded by many would-be conquerors, hungry to subjugate our people. While our native terrain can slow down hostile armies, it also makes it difficult for our own troops to respond to threats swiftly. A strong cavalry, however, will allow us to quickly react to any threats, no matter how many there might be.

In the times of foreign rule, many of our people established predominantly Kurdish quarters in cities. While these areas prospered even under distant rulers, we can now utilize their wealth directly, and better guarantee a prosperous future for our people.

Our people have long served as hired swords for foreign lords, gaining valuable combat experience in their service. With our own country now established, it is time to call those experienced fighters under our banner.

Our rulers must not just be capable warriors; they must also be educated in the matters of fine art and effective administration. By writing texts and documenting their reigns, our leaders will pass the knowledge and history of our people down through generations, ensuring no valuable insight is lost.

items.name: Lotharingia
items.desc: As the new claimants to the Lotharingian crown, we confirmed our legitimacy by appealing to the legacy of … and …. Under our patronage, the exploits of our ancestors have once again become common knowledge, both among our own people and throughout the courts of Europe.

items.name: Malaya
items.desc: Situated on a crucial maritime trade route, the straits of … have always maintained control of the trade flowing through, and thus control of its wealth. Perfectly positioned to benefit from this trade, and holding a land itself rich in resources and tradition, the … people have always flourished in these lands. With a unified identity, they will flourish even more.

adv.d: We are a people shaped by wind and tide. From childhood, we learn the ways of the monsoon, the pulse of the straits, and the call of the open ocean. Our sailors carry this knowledge into every voyage, earning renown across the archipelago for their courage and mastery.

Across the scattered isles of our homeland lie countless shores awaiting our touch. By strengthening our presence among these islands, we secure the wealth of our people: new trade posts, new harvests, and new communities bound by the waves that unite us.

The Sama and other sea-wandering peoples have long lived upon the water itself, drifting between islands with unmatched skill. Through knowledge-sharing or agreements of mutual respect and shared opportunity, we shall ensure safe passage and swift repairs.

Wherever our traders land, be it the coasts of South Asia or the markets of distant China, they are respected for their sharp tongues and keen judgement. Navigating both seas and bargains with equal finesse, they ensure that our trades are never at a disadvantage.

From the bazaars of Arabia to the harbors of East Asia, our merchants are a familiar sight. Their presence forms a vast network of cooperation, easing the establishment of our enclaves abroad and extending our reach into every great entrepôt of the world.

Trading in cloves holds much wealth for us and our people. By securing the lands and seas from which these spices flow, we stand at the center of a trade that spans the world, and no merchant can ignore the allure of these goods.

items.name: Manchu
items.desc: The people of … have a long history of both nomadic tribal living and frequent interactions with the …. As such, we have blended aspects from many cultures and places to create our own distinct way of life. Although we are usually divided into numerous tribes, a united … may be able to claim hegemony over all China. Shall we press forward with unification?

adv.d: Our people descend from the Mohe tribes of the Amur forests. Their traditions of hunting, herding, and hardy frontier life shape our society.
Our ties with the Warka have given us great knowledge in hunting and gathering food. Through these practices, we ensure our people stay fed, even during long winters.
The tradition of the Five Noble Talents involves riding, archery, military command, loyalty, and discipline. These aspects of our martial society form the backbone of our proud culture.
The unification of the Jurchen tribes is but the first step in our ambitious rise to power. Soon, our name will strike fear and awe across the entire continent.
From foreign scholars and texts, we shall adopt new administrative, military, and scholarly practices, accelerating the pace of our technological development.
China is home to immeasurable wealth, prestige, and knowledge. Under the rule of a weak dynasty, it falls upon our shoulders to seize power and return the prosperity and splendor of these lands.

items.name: Marathas

pot.t: Any primary, accepted or tolerated culture:

items.desc: The … peoples have been fragmented for many years, but remain proud of our literary achievements and unique language. While unification may not be foremost in our peoples' minds, … warriors all over Deccan will gather to our banners if we show clear leadership and acquire all the great forts of the Desh. Let us unite the clans, and go forth to rule India once and for all!

items.name: Mexico

c.t: Any primary, accepted or tolerated culture:

items.desc: The lands of … are rich and plentiful, with a diverse population and a long history of civilization. Yet we are fractured between different groups, and weakened by internal bickering over power and resources between those groups. It is time we establish a new identity for all of us, one that shows off our strength, power, and enviable history while also presenting a unified and impenetrable front to the rest of the world.

items.name: Mongolia

allow.t: Is not in a civil war

items.desc: The people of Mongolia have not seen unity since the times of the great … Khān. It is now in our hands to unify the tribes once again and march into a new era of conquests.

items.name: Nusantara
items.desc: … is a rich land, overflowing with precious resources and luxuries. Although its people are varied and diverse, many of their traditional cultural aspects are the same, mainly due to the diffusive effects of maritime trade. Were we to unite these many islands and peoples under one banner, we would be a strong contender for ultimate regional dominance.

adv.d: No matter their origin or destination, every trader in Asia will eventually have to cross our lands, bringing both precious goods and tales of their travels with them.

Our islands are home to many different people, speaking different languages and believing in many different gods. Only if we establish a common understanding and tolerance between them can we secure a prosperous country.

items.name: Occitania
items.desc: The lands of Occitania have always had their own distinguishing traits. Even the noun itself denotes that difference, as its appellation as the land of òc, makes it clearly distinct from the lands of si and oïl. These shared cultural bonds entice the people of Occitania to unite under a single banner, and to proudly display their idiosyncrasy.

items.name: Poland-Lithuania

c.t: We must either destroy …, make them our …, or be in a … with them
We must either destroy …, make them our …, or be in a … with them

items.desc: By uniting the crowns of Lithuania and Poland under the same banner, we will become a beacon of hope and faith in Eastern Europe, bringing our light to the heart of even the darkest forests flourishing across our lands.

adv.d: The fertile fields of our domain are home to Europe's richest grain crops, in part thanks to the Folwark System. Through our grace, we supply the markets beyond our borders, ensuring our people continue to prosper and never go hungry.

The hussars were originally light cavalry troops used for scouting, but with the decline of the old feudal army, we have switched over to professional regiments, the core of which shall be made up of these heavier, armored hussars. The fear of these winged warriors shall make our enemies tremble in the night like children!

The evolution of Polish hussars entailed the adoption of heavier armor with red and white colors. They used a longer lance of around six meters, which made their charge incredibly devastating, often breaking the morale of their foes and causing them to rout.

If we are to survive and continue to prosper, our governmental mechanism must run efficiently and be based on robust foundations. The parliament shall adopt modernized procedures and strengthen its authority. The goals of this evolution are to curtail the power of the nobility and mitigate the escalating abuses of serfdom.

Our government's need for capable administrators has led to systematic education reform. We will establish the first education ministry in Europe, devoted to spreading literacy throughout our population, which will hopefully lead to an increase in qualified candidates to staff our expanding administration.
By establishing the 'Knight's School' to train noble youth in military science and their patriotic duty, we will forge generations of capable, dedicated military and civil personnel.

items.name: Pontus
items.desc: Founded by Mithridates I Ktistes (meaning the Builder), Pontus became a vibrant and wealthy crossroads between Persian and Anatolian roots, blended with Hellenistic influences. Strategically positioned between easily defensible mountainous terrain and seafaring … coastal communities, the Kingdom prospered, including important cities such as Amaseia and Sinope. At the height of its power, the realm stretched from the depths of … to the coasts of …. By reasserting such a glorious legacy, we affirm our right to rule these lands in an undisputed manner.

items.name: Punjab
items.desc: The … people are only too familiar with foreign invasions, having endured wave after wave of conquest over the centuries. But these incursions have led to enormous advances in our economic and religious practices, as well as a flourishing of literary arts. But we must unite the … people if we wish to ever stand on our own against foreign invaders. Together, we will build a modern state with armies capable of taking on anyone who wishes to seize our territories and crush our faith!

items.name: Rajputana
items.desc: The lands of … have been shattered and weak ever since the Muslim invasion. But that was centuries ago, and our people have begun to raise their heads from the yoke of our oppressors, seeking a place closer to the stars where we belong. We must reclaim the legendary cities held by the great dynasties that came before us, and unite the princes of …!

items.name: Romania
items.desc: The last vestiges of the Roman Empire are gone, and although many pretenders claim the imperial crown, only we are its true descendants. When the lands of our ancestors have finally been reunited under a single flag, only then will we be rewarded with the prosperity that is our birthright. We are the children of Rome - the people of Romania!

adv.d: As enemy tides recede, the Latin-speaking people of the Carpathians recognize their shared Roman heritage. By formalizing the oral histories and legal traditions of the 'Vlachs', we create a unified cultural identity that transcends the fragmented Knezates and Voivodeships. This Romanitas provides the ideological glue needed to bind the mountain clans into a cohesive state.

By securing the establishment of the Metropolises in our lands, we achieve spiritual and political independence from foreign ecclesiastical influence. This religious autonomy allows the Romanian crown to use the Church as an administrative arm, ensuring the loyalty of the boyars through divine sanction. The Church becomes the primary sponsor of Romanian literacy and law.

Inspired by the glory of Constantinople, the Romanian princes have bound themselves to be the primary patrons of Mount Athos and the Orthodox East. By positioning ourselves as heirs to the Byzantine cultural legacy, we attract scholars and artists from across the Balkans. Romania is now 'more Byzantium than Byzantium', the faith capital of the Orthodox world.

We have issued the first printed collection of laws in our nation, the Carte Românească de Învățătură. This monumental work seeks to unify the legal practices of our realm and align them with broader European jurisprudence. By professionalizing the courts and standardizing punishments, we have reduced the arbitrary power of the local boyars and strengthened the central authority of the throne, making our state a model of Eastern Orthodox legalism and order.

The publication of the first complete Bible in the Romanian language has fundamentally shifted our cultural identity from the liturgical Church Slavonic to the living vernacular. This monumental work acts as a linguistic unifier, standardizing the dialects of Wallachia, Moldavia, and Transylvania into a single literary tongue. By making the sacred texts accessible to the common man, we have laid the foundation for a unified national consciousness that transcends the political borders of the three separate principalities.

Our nation has seen the rise of the Panduri, a highly motivated irregular infantry force drawn from among our free peasantry and petty gentry. These soldiers specialize in guerrilla warfare and rapid movement through the Danubian marshes, proving that a native, ideologically driven force could challenge both enemy and Boyar retinues. The Pandur tradition will become the blueprint for the first professional and modern native Romanian national army.

items.name: Ruthenia
items.desc: Centuries ago, the land of the Rus' was united under a single banner and ruled from the legendary city of …. But the Mongol hordes advanced from the great steppe, pillaging and burning as they went. Even great … itself could not avoid this fate. In terror, our people fled north into the hinterlands we today call Russia. Now a new, arrogant northern city is on the rise. Its ruler envisions a new Rus' — A Rus' centered in … and not …. But we Ruthenians will not allow pretenders to claim the legacy of our forefathers! … shall rise once again, and so too shall the Rus'!

items.name: Ryūkyū
items.desc: Inhabited by the … people and boasting a unique culture and identity, the islands of … have always been fragmented due to their own nature. However, uniting the kingdoms of the three mountains would build a nation of great prosperity and culture — one that could change the entire course of history.

items.name: Scandinavia
items.desc: For untold centuries, the Kingdoms of the North have been divided and locked in internecine power struggles. If we want to stand tall amongst the great powers of the world, we must strive to create a lasting union between our peoples, as difficult as this might seem.

adv.d: The union of Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland under one crown has turned the North from a battleground of competing kings into a centralized power. With unified administration and increased cooperation among the estates, we can assert stronger control over the realm.

Though the Kalmar Union dissolved in conflict, it established a precedent for shared Nordic sovereignty. Drawing upon this legacy, we reaffirm our authority and remind our subjects that unity brings strength, not subjugation.

Control over the Øresund grants us the right to impose the Sound Toll on all foreign ships passing through the Danish straits. This ancient privilege turns geographic advantage into tangible wealth, strengthening our dominance over northern trade.

Denmark's long naval traditions and its mastery of maritime logistics culminated in major dockyards like those in Copenhagen. As Scandinavia, we inherit these powerful infrastructures and traditions, boosting our diplomatic standing and naval readiness.

The Finnish cavalry — Hakkapeliitta — gained a fearsome reputation in wars in Europe These riders, raised in the wild forests and plains of Finland, bring experience, adaptability, and toughness to our ranks. By formalizing their role, we will create a permanent elite force within our armies.

Norway's rugged coastlines and maritime traditions have shaped a people skilled in seafaring, fishing, and navigation. The legacy of Norwegian fishermen and shipbuilders fuels our naval endeavors and bolsters the lifeblood of our coastal communities.

c.t: Is or was the country Sweden (SWE)

adv.d: From the disciplined Carolean ranks to the strong freeholding peasantry, Sweden's military prowess is an essential pillar of Scandinavia. By integrating Swedish institutions and recruitment systems, we reinforce the manpower and strength of our empire.

items.name: Shan
items.desc: The … peoples of the … have long been masters of our domain. We have carved the surrounding hills into terraced farms; we have built temples that will stand forever in testament to our gods. Yet we are also cursed by being trapped between larger, more powerful nations, often swept up in their fighting. But no more — although we were once divided, we Shan now stand as one against them all!

items.name: Siam
items.desc: The … people live divided by mountains and river valleys, between overlapping spheres of influence, and thus have always gravitated towards local centers of power rather than a central authority. But a unified … homeland would be more beneficial than our current dispersed nature — that consolidation of our power would make it much easier to lead our people to greatness.

adv.d: We have extensive political experience. The birth of our country was something achieved not only with the power of our military, after all. Surely our diplomatic reputation will prove to be a source of our influence on the world stage.
There are many parts of our country with very low population. We should improve conditions in these regions to ensure that no part of our country is seen as lackluster, and all of it shines equally.
It is not uncommon for our greatest poems to dedicate lines of text to list and honor our war elephants individually. Let us show our enemies why!
A decentralized system may cause us to lose control over our more distant provinces. If we are to be the true unifying realm for the Thai people, our provinces must be unified as well.

As our Lord Buddha said, we shall not accept something because it is often said, but we need to experience it ourselves. Education is the basis of knowledge, and if we want to excel at technology, we need to excel at education first.
Second only to Heaven — that is what a ruler should be. Honored and worshipped, our leaders rule over the Earth as the Gods rule over Heaven.
We are undoubtedly the leaders of all Thai people. Our troops are proud to serve as defenders of our culture and identity itself, and they fight fiercely for the privilege.

items.name: Slovakia
items.desc: Ever since the collapse of the Great Moravian State, the … people have been ruled by foreign powers, who govern over us with little regard to our interests. But during this dark period, we have slowly but surely been growing our power, our people drawing closer together in solidarity. It is finally time to assert our sovereignty and establish a state free from foreign rule.

adv.n: The Law of the Seven Towns
adv.d: Recognizing the immense strategic and financial value of the northern territories, King Charles Robert of Anjou bypassed the unruly local barons by granting special 'Royal Free Town' status to the primary mining centers, such as Banská Štiavnica and Kremnica. These settlements were removed from the jurisdiction of local lords and placed directly under the Tavernicus (the royal treasurer), creating a direct financial link between the mountain mines and the throne. This legal framework has fostered a loyal, urbanized tax base and a German-Slavic merchant class that has operated independently of feudal land-rights. This administrative shift has ensured that our nation has a reliable source of liquid capital, funding the central government's efforts to stabilize the realm and professionalize the royal bureaucracy.

Faced with threats from all sides, we will establish a formalized military border along the Danube and the Carpathian foothills. We will empower the Zeman — the lower, land-owning Slavic nobility — to act as a permanent, hereditary frontier guard. These warriors live in Curias (fortified manor houses) and are exempt from certain taxes in exchange for their constant readiness to mobilize. This will create a resilient social class of warrior-farmers who are intimately familiar with the local terrain, providing the state with a cost-effective and highly motivated defensive screen that will be able to absorb the shock of foreign invasions before they reach the heart of the realm.

We are at the height of the Humanist movement, meaning that we have a great opportunity to found a university in Bratislava (Academia Istropolitana) to become a magnet for the brightest minds of our era, including scholars from Italy, Poland, and the German states. The curriculum will emphasize the new sciences of astronomy, mathematics, and Roman law, modernizing the state's diplomatic and legal apparatus. This intellectual boom will ensure that the ruling elite are educated in the latest European political philosophies, allowing the state to navigate the complex international relations of the Renaissance with professional skill. The university will also serve as a center for astronomical research, placing the Slovak lands at the forefront of the scientific revolution that is beginning to sweep across the continent.

Our mountains are full of ore, so the state will formalize the central management of the 'Seven Towns' through the Bergkammer (Mining Chamber) in Banská Štiavnica. By appointing a royal Berghauptmann (Mining Captain), the government will seize direct control over the extraction and smelting of silver and gold, stripping local feudal lords of their ancient mineral rights. This professionalization of the industry will allow for the implementation of advanced drainage technologies and deeper shaft mining, ensuring a constant flow of bullion to the royal mints. This financial engine will provide us with the liquid capital necessary to fulfill our needs, making the Slovak Ore Mountains indispensable to us.

For decades, the cultural figure of the Zbojník (Highland Outlaw), epitomized by Juraj Jánošík, has become a military ideal in the minds of our people. This is the 'Culture of the Forest', where young men flee into the mountains to wage a guerrilla war against feudal oppression. While we have viewed them as bandits, the populace sees them as defenders. This cultural archetype has fostered a partisan mindset in the Slovak psyche: a distrust of central authority and a mastery of the scorched earth and mountain ambush tactics that can serve us well if we manage to nationalize.

The discovery of massive iron ore deposits and the rapid advancement of steam technology have led to the birth of the first modern industrial zones in the Hron and Váh river valleys. The state must heavily subsidize the creation of iron-works and textile factories to reduce our dependency on foreign imports. This drive for industrial sovereignty will transform the traditional agricultural landscape into a manufacturing powerhouse, providing us with the tools to compete with the other powers. The concentration of labor in these new industrial hubs will begin to shift the social dynamics of the region, creating an urban working class that will become a new political force in the century to follow.

items.name: Sokoto
items.desc: The presence of … in the region of Western … is ever-precarious. With so many different peoples represented in our population, we run the risk of religious conflict erupting at any moment, both inside and coming from outside our borders. Under the guidance of our …, we must establish an orthodox Islamic state to ensure the survival of … people in this region.

adv.d: For too long the people of Western Africa have labored under rulers that, while professing to be righteous, indulged in syncretism. No more! Our flag shall always fly above that of worldly kingdoms!
Everyone who is ready to serve under our righteous leaders must be welcome, regardless of their heritage.

By encouraging the spread of literacy and scholarship among men and women alike, we can advance our society and further our hold over our lands. The family of our rulers must have a special place in these efforts, serving as an ideal to emulate.

Instead of displaying the worldly pomp of our rule, our court should focus on spiritual matters. By inviting learned religious figures to teach in our capital, we can show our true commitment to our faith.
The Fulbe people are distinguished warriors, serving as leaders in all corners of Western Africa. We should establish ourselves as a permanent employer for their most capable commanders.
Our lands are home to many people of different cultures and languages. We must emphasize our faith as the unifying force, joining all people under one banner.

items.name: Timurid
items.desc: The many battles fought by our ancestors may have soaked the earth in blood, but that bloodshed in turn fed the soil, and from this adversity was born a race of warriors, architects, artists, and scientists. The time has come to share our many gifts with the world by stepping forward as a great nation. We will follow …'s legacy, and lead our people to greatness!

adv.d: As the great Genghis Khān dominated the steppes with the power of his cavalry, so will we triumph through our incomparable horses. Bred for the most rigorous combat, and mounted by the best-trained soldiers in the world, our cavalry will instill fear in the hearts of our enemies.
This new variety of chess, invented by our great eponymous founder, improves upon previous versions. Using it will help our generals to improve their strategic and tactical skills.

adv.n: The Mantle of the Great Khān
adv.d: The death of Genghis Khān created a power vacuum that led to people who should have known better vying to replace him. However, through strategic marriages, we have consolidated our claim to descent from the Great Khān himself, and the warriors of the steppes will declare their loyalty to us accordingly.

The architecture of Persia has been the envy of the known world for centuries. We must promote a new form of architecture, one that surpasses anything seen before, so that we may claim our birthright as the master of this art.

Persia has always been the undeniable center of culture and language in the region, influencing the different Turkic peoples that have been around for centuries. We will embrace this blend of cultures to create our own unique tradition.

The Karluk language of the eastern steppes is far more worthy to carry the thoughts and ideas of our great lineage than Persian or Arabic ever could be. We must promote the use of our ancestral language, and create a new literary tradition.

The Nambardar Levy, or čerig-i nambardar, refers to our troops that do not come from Mongolian or Turkic origins, but instead come from the native Iranian population. Thanks to them, we can build larger armies than would have been possible before.
As long as our merchants control the trade through the lands of Transoxiana and Samarkand, the trade of the Silk Road shall flow unhindered and the wealth of our dynasty will continue to grow.

Ever since the initial Timurid expansion, our realm has attracted the greatest artisans and wise men of the age. Through our continued patronage of art, science, and literature, we have made the cities of Herāt and Samarkand the brightest jewels in the world.

We are fortunate to be served by loyal and well-educated Farsi administrators, who have perfected the art of governance for generations. Sadly, however, a hereditary office is one that over time might stagnate and lack innovation. By reducing the number of inherited offices with each generation, we can make sure that we reward not only loyalty, but also ability. Able administrators must rise to high positions regardless of which family they come from.

Our glorious empire emerged from the legacy of great conquerors. It was the ferocity of Genghis Khān's troops that allowed him to conquer from Europe to China. As his successors, our troops will be as fearsome as the ones in his army.

items.name: Two Sicilies
items.desc: The Two Sicilies...not a country, but a dream. A dream to unify the lands kissed by the waters of the Straits of Messina — the Sicilies that stand on both sides of the 'Punta del Faro.' It is our duty to make that dream come true.

adv.d: The territories which constitute our land have suffered revolts due to unjust applications of laws. In order to prevent these occurrences in the future, we should standardize our legal code and ensure our laws are applied fairly. This will surely prevent any uprising from spiraling into chaos.

The Noble Families of both Sicilies exert much power in our stead. By granting them prestigious yet meaningless roles at court, we will ensure their loyalty and guarantee stable rule over our countryside.

Previous rulers put too much focus on particular areas of our country. If we want to retain control of both Sicilies, we will have to invest equally and fairly in both parts. One step towards this goal is attracting people to settle in previously neglected areas.

Expanding our territories within Italy is a difficult task, navigating a treacherous web of alliances and risking the anger of the Pope himself. Therefore, we should look overseas, where potential riches await us in the lands of northern Africa and Greece.

A particular struggle of our unified country is governing both sides of the Strait of Messina. Since our ruler can only be present on one side at a time, the other will have to be given to a vicar, ruling in our name. We must be sure to appoint only the most capable and trustworthy people to this vital role to prevent corruption.
Our coastline is vast, and vulnerable to raids by pirates hunting for slaves. We need to establish a navy to patrol, protect, and eventually defeat this vile threat to our people.

items.name: Yamato
items.desc: The … is ancient, and claims descent from the gods themselves. Their very existence grants them a claim to the divine leadership of all …. And who would be so arrogant as to stand against the seed of the gods and their rightful rule?

items.name: Yuán
items.desc: Yuán

items.name: Albania
items.desc: Traditionally a land of diverse beliefs and disparate clans, we have finally united the Albanian people under a single banner and purpose. Now that we have expelled unwelcome outsiders and created a nascent state, Albania shall emerge as the heroic home nation of all Albanian people.

adv.d: Our latest crowned heads can be traced directly to the lineage of the Capetian House of Anjou, specifically established by Charles I of Naples to serve as his gateway into the Byzantine heartlands. This connection grants us a unique Western prestige among the fragmented Balkan lords, allowing us to claim a seat at the table of the great Catholic monarchs of Europe. By upholding the honors and heraldry of the Lily, we distinguish our sovereignty from that of mere tribal chieftains.

As the power of our foes wanes, our great houses have united to ensure the survival of our nation. By leveraging our position between the Catholic West and the Orthodox East, we have become masters of maritime diplomacy and coastal trade. This strategic autonomy allows us to navigate the rivalries of neighbors to our own benefit.

Our urban centers continue to operate under both the sophisticated principles of Byzantine Law and the modern bureaucracies of the West. This legal continuity provides a stable framework for contracts, property rights, and inheritance that attracts foreign merchants and scholars to our courts. A predictable legal system is the foundation of our growing administrative strength.

As the primary port for Western intervention, we have modernized the shipyards of Durrës to maintain a permanent fleet of galleys. This infrastructure allows us to project power across the Adriatic, ensuring that the sea lanes between Naples and Albania remain open for reinforcements and trade. Our control of the harbor makes us the undisputed masters of the western Balkan coastline.

Positioned as the easternmost outpost of the Roman Church, we have become the primary shield against both Orthodox schismatics and Turkish heathens. This sacred duty gives us an inner peace that infuses the entire realm, transforming our struggle into a crusade for our soul.

b: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle: +10%
adv.d: Despite our communities being divided by faith, our nation is devoted to Christ, earning us the title of Athleta Christi. Our relentless faith has drawn the eyes of the Papacy and the Patriarchs, securing us financial subsidies and military volunteers. We fight not just for our land, but for the very survival of the 'Word of Christ'.

Our position allows us to act as the essential bridge between the Italian city-states and the rugged Balkan interior. Our diplomats are trained to navigate both the Venetian Senate and tribal councils, making our mediation indispensable for trade and war.

Over time, a good number of our people have emigrated abroad and formed Arbëreshë communities. These 'Albanians across the sea' maintain our language and traditions while gaining influence in their new homes. They serve as permanent diplomatic envoys there, constantly lobbying for support for the homeland.

The merchants of our coast have become the primary carriers of trade between the Balkans and the West. By utilizing the Greek language for commerce and Albanian for loyalty, they dominate the markets from Venice to Constantinople. These merchant marines are the lifeblood of our modernizing economy.

We will not rest until the borders of the ancient Kingdom are restored to their greatest extent and beyond, reclaiming our place as masters of the Balkans. This centralizing mission allows us to integrate newly conquered territories with minimal friction as we restore 'rightful' rule.

Following the European trend, our monarchs have centralized power, stripping the old clans of their feudal privileges in favor of a modern state. This move has allowed us to implement universal taxation and a national judicial system, turning the kingdom into a streamlined machine of war.

Our 'National Rebirth' or Rilindja has ignited a fire in the hearts of Albanians everywhere, from the mountains of the north to the diaspora in Italy and Egypt. This cultural and political movement has unified all Albanians under the common banner of 'Albanianism'. We are a nation reborn, ready to take our place among the sovereign states of Europe.

items.name: Algiers
items.desc: The central Maghreb has scattered its strength among corsair ports, mountain confederations, and desert sultanates, each proud and each alone. We shall gather the Tell, the Kabyle highlands, and the gateways of the Sahara beneath a single throne, turning fractious coasts and restless tribes into one sovereign power. Let Algiers stand as the beating heart of a realm that answers to no master but itself.

adv.d: Our fortress-quarter, the qasba of Algiers perched on the hillside above the harbor with its honeycomb of narrow alleys and tightly-built houses, provides the defensive seat from which every Algerian regime governs. Our resident garrisons hold the citadel against any landward or seaward attack, our cisterns store enough water and grain for an extended siege, and our gatekeepers control access to the upper city even when the lower harbor is held by an enemy. This kasbah citadel gives our polity a fortified administrative core that the more open Maghrebi coastal cities cannot match for defensive resilience.

Our dynasty, the Banū Tha'ālibī, traced through Sīdī 'Abd ar-Raḥmān ath-Tha'ālibī and his ancestors back to Idrīs II of Morocco and the Prophet's grandson Ḥasan, establishes a sharīfī lineage in the central Maghreb that no Berber dynasty can match for prophetic-genealogical authority. Our court genealogists certify the descent at each accession, our recital of the lineage at every bay'a ceremony binds the religious caste to the ruling family, and our nobles-and-ulema consensus around the sharifian claim survives every internal succession-dispute. This sharifian-descent claim gives the original Algiers line a sacral legitimacy that no successor adopting the Algerian state-form can replicate from genealogical fact.

Algiers emerges as the central coastal emporium of the central Maghreb. Merchants of Pisa, Genoa, Aragon, and Provence maintain resident factors in our harbor, our customs revenue from Christian trade rivals the income of the inland tribute, and our shipwrights at the harbor-front yards build both the coastal traders and the early war-galleys that our captains crew. Our merchant-guilds intermediate the wool, wax, leather, coral, and slaves that flow between the Tell hinterland and the Mediterranean markets, and our consul-treaty regime grants formal residence and judicial protection to the visiting foreign factors. This commercial emergence gives Algiers a port-revenue and sailor-pool foundation that the later corsair-era state-form is built upon.

The Tha'alibid emirate ruling Algiers, proclaimed under the religious-political authority of the Banū Tha'ālibī family and exercising state powers across the central-Maghrebi coast from Cherchell to Dellys, maintains a continuous diplomatic-and-commercial relations regime with the Aragonese, Genoese, and Hafsid neighbors that the later regency inherits in form if not in dynastic continuity. Our court chancellery exchanges sealed letters with the Christian powers under formal capitulations, our ports admit foreign factors under negotiated residence-rights, and our coinage bears the sharifian titulature that distinguishes our emirate from the Zayyanid Tlemcen and Hafsid Tunis polities. This pre-regency emirate gives the original Algiers line a state-form patrimony that no successor regime restores in equivalent dynastic terms.

The Algiers Ojaq Janissaries are the musketeer ojaq of the Algerian Regency, an Ottoman-trained Janissary garrison founded after the Barbarossa brothers took Algiers and steadily reinforced with Anatolian recruits. They hold the Kasbah and the coastal forts and elect their own Aga, who shares power with the Dey.

The corsair tradition takes root in Algiers. Captains from across the Mediterranean settle in our harbor under state charter, our shipwrights specialize in the fast galley-and-galiot classes that the open-water raiding war demands, and our captains' guild formalizes the prize-distribution rules that turn private raiding into a state-organized industry. Our renegade Christian, Greek, and Italian captains serve alongside native rais; our markets re-export the captured cargoes and ransomed captives; and our crown takes its share of every successful prize. This corsair emergence gives Algiers a maritime war-economy that the more agriculturally-anchored Maghrebi rivals cannot replicate from their own captain-traditions.

Our emirate resists the multiple foreign pressures bearing down on Algiers in the late-medieval period: Spanish coastal raids and Cardinal Cisneros's expeditions, foreign corsair-captains looking for a base under any pretext of religious solidarity, and the periodic Hafsid-Zayyanid neighbors seeking to incorporate us into their tributary networks. We retain seasoned mercenary and corsair companies whose upkeep our treasury has learned to bear, we press the siege against every foreign strongpoint planted on our coast — the Spanish-held Peñón foremost among them — and our diplomats negotiate the temporary truces that preserve our autonomous polity through each successive wave of foreign pressure. This martial tradition gives the original Algiers line an expeditionary-military patrimony that the later regency, paradoxically, would inherit and turn against the same powers.

The corsair-state economy reaches its mature form. Our crown licenses every prize-taking captain, our treasury draws a fixed share of every successful raid, and our shipyards turn out the standard galley, galiot, and xebec classes that our captains lease from the state on prize-share terms. Our recruiting agents draw foreign captains and crews to our harbor with state-funded advances on the next prize-cycle, our naval-administration office tracks the war-statuses of every Mediterranean power to direct the raiding effort, and our central treasury depends on the prize-revenue cycle as much as on the customs-and-tribute flows. This state-organized corsair economy gives our polity a war-revenue stream that the more conventional trading polities of the Mediterranean cannot match for institutional integration.

Our dynasty, restored to the throne after the foreign-officer interregnum and the upheavals that followed, reasserts the indigenous Algerian sovereignty that the original Tha'alibid line carried before its extinction. Our court re-establishes the diplomatic networks that the regency's chancellery had let lapse, our envoys re-engage the Mediterranean and trans-Saharan powers under the restored sharifian-legitimacy framework, and our scholar-historians produce the chronicles that justify the restoration in continuity-of-legitimacy terms. This restoration gives the original Algiers line a re-established diplomatic reach that purely-state-form successors could not muster in equivalent legitimacy terms.

The deylik settles into a stable political order: the dey rules from the Janina palace, the provincial beys remit tribute and troops, the Janissary corps stands as the army, and the corsair captains' guild keeps its voice in his election. After generations of coups and rotating officers, the treasury, the prize-licensing office, and the diplomatic apparatus at last run from a single Bardo-palace bureaucracy. This consolidated deylik gives our polity an administrative coherence the old rotating-officer governance could never sustain.

Our dynasty, elevated to sultanate status as the restored Algerian polity matures into a fully sovereign state, claims the same titulature and ceremonial protocol that the Hafsid and Marinid sovereigns wielded, distinguished from the Janissary-promoted deylik form by the unbroken dynastic-genealogical continuity that no rotating-officer regime can match. Our court at the Bardo-equivalent palace stages the formal accession ceremonies, our scholars compile the sultanate's claim-to-sovereignty in juridical commentaries, and our nobles' consensus binds the polity through dynastic-loyalty rather than corps-election. This Tha'alibid sultanate gives the original Algiers line a state-form fit for its sharifian legitimacy claim, where the dey-regency form rooted in Janissary promotion could not provide it.

Our consular-relations regime, with formal consulates from every major Mediterranean and Atlantic power resident in Algiers, periodic treaty renewals with each, and the customary gift-and-payment arrangements that accompany them, manages the polity's relations with rivals more powerful than any single defeat could humble. Our dey audiences the consular delegations on a fixed protocol, our chancellery files the running correspondence in multiple languages, and our customs office administrates the differential tariffs that each treaty-state's merchants enjoy. This formalized consular-and-treaty regime gives Algiers a diplomatic-administrative flexibility that the more isolated North African polities cannot match for managing the modern multi-power configuration.

Our reformist circles revive the Tha'alibid heritage as the ideological-cultural anchor of the modern Algerian polity, invoking the centuries before the Janissary interregnum when an indigenous sharifian dynasty governed central Algeria with continuous diplomatic-and-commercial engagement with the Mediterranean world. Our pamphleteers publish the Tha'alibid chronicles in modern Arabic editions, our schoolmasters teach the early-modern Algerian history alongside the Maghrebi-wide canonical narrative, and our scholar-circles around the Sīdī 'Abd ar-Raḥmān shrine in Algiers maintain the unbroken religious-cultural authority that no political extinction could fully erase. This Tha'alibid revival gives the original Algiers line a heritage-ideological patrimony that purely-state-form modernization movements elsewhere lack.

items.name: Aragon
items.desc: The Crown of Aragon was forged through the dynastic union of the highland kingdom and the maritime principalities of the Mediterranean coast, a partnership that has carried our banners from Zaragoza as far afield as Sicily and Naples. We must restore this royal patrimony and reclaim our rightful place among the great powers of Europe.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Almogavars are a class of light infantry soldiers originating from the Crown of Aragon. These quick-moving warriors serve as frontier defenders and foot soldiers. In addition to their role in the Reconquista, they have also found employment as mercenaries in Italy, the Frankokratia, and the Levant.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Some of the fiercest and deadliest crossbowmen in the Western Mediterranean, the Catalan Crossbowmen compete against the Genoese Crossbowmen for supremacy in this field.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: The Catalan Galley is a larger version of the ancient Greek galleys that once dominated the Mediterranean Sea.

The descent from the Pyrenean valleys onto the plain of the Ebro crowns generations of frontier war: Huesca falls in 1096, and Alfonso el Batallador storms Zaragoza in 1118 to make it the seat of the kingdom. Our light frontier foot soldiers, hardened in the long march south and skilled in the reduction of walled Moorish towns, turns each captured stronghold into a base for the next advance. This conquering tradition gives the inland kingdom a soldiery built for taking fortresses rather than for the sea.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Desperta Ferro! — Awake Iron! — is the war cry of the Almogavars, accompanied by the striking of lance shafts and darts against flint to draw sparks before the charge. The cry was heard at the conquest of Mallorca under James I in 1229, on the slopes of the Bosphorus under Roger de Flor's Catalan Company, and in every Aragonese campaign of the long Mediterranean century. This battlefield ritual binds our infantry into a single chanting mass before contact, producing a shock effect that has unnerved Byzantines, Sicilians, and French alike.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: From the dynastic union of Aragon and the County of Barcelona in 1164, our Crown has built a Mediterranean commercial system anchored on Barcelona, Valencia, and Palma.
