The Consolat de Mar — the world's first standing maritime trade tribunal — adjudicates disputes from Pisa to Famagusta under Catalan law, and our consuls hold writ in every major port from Alexandria to Bruges. This commercial-legal infrastructure makes the Crown of Aragon the indispensable middleman between Italian banks, African gold, and Levantine spices.

Minted at Jaca since the first kings of Aragon, the dinero jaqués becomes the trusted coin of the kingdom, its silver content guarded by the Cortes against every royal temptation to debase it. A sound currency lets the crown borrow cheaply, the merchants reckon honestly, and the treasury may collect its revenues without the friction of clipped and doubtful coin. This monetary stability underwrites the kingdom's finances more reliably than any single tax.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: The Almogavars, embracing new innovations, have undergone remarkable adaptations to enhance their efficiency on the battlefield. Integrating cutting-edge weaponry and strategic advancements into their traditional tactics, these formidable warriors have become even more formidable. With a blend of ancient expertise and modern tools, they stand as a prime example of the seamless fusion between tradition and innovation in warfare.

Our kingdom's standing executive — the Diputación del General — emerges from the Cortes of Monzón as a permanent commission that administers the general subsidio, defends the realm's fueros between Cortes sessions, and represents the four estates in continuous dialogue with the Crown. We will channel the kingdom's tax revenue through the Diputación's accounting offices, fund public works through its commissions, and lodge the noble houses' grievances in its standing chamber. This permanent institution gives our realm a parliamentary continuity and fiscal coordination that the Crown's other realms must rebuild from scratch each session.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Beyond the sea the Crown gathers a constellation of realms — Sicily won in 1282, Sardinia in 1324, and Naples under Alfonso el Magnánimo — each kept as a distinct kingdom under a viceroy rather than absorbed. We bind these realms to the dynasty with confirmed privileges, native magistracies, and a light hand on their liberties, so that their nobilities find more profit in loyalty than in revolt. This federation of overseas crowns yields the dynasty a steady tribute and a chain of Mediterranean bases no rival can easily prise loose.

The stony terraces of Cariñena and Campo de Borja, baked by the dry interior sun and swept by the cierzo wind, yield a dark, powerful wine prized far beyond the kingdom. Monastic cellars and town guilds expand the plantings across the Ebro depression, and the vintage travels by river and mule to the courts and garrisons of the crown. This robust viticulture turns thin upland soil into one of the inland kingdom's most valuable and durable exports.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Since forming the dynastic union with the County of Barcelona in 1164, the Crown has functioned as a composite monarchy in which each component realm — Aragon proper, Catalonia, Valencia, Mallorca, and Sardinia — preserves its own Corts, fueros, and currency. To strengthen central administration without abolishing these liberties, we will rationalize the chancery, standardize royal tax collection across the realms, and reinforce the office of the Lloctinent General, who governs in the absence of the king. This administrative consolidation lets the Crown coordinate war, taxation, and diplomacy with a speed that no other composite monarchy in Europe can match.

At Zaragoza rises the great baroque Basílica del Pilar, raised over the pillar where tradition holds the Virgin appeared to Saint James, drawing pilgrims from across the Spains. The crown endows its chapter, processes beneath its towers on the great feasts, and wraps its legitimacy in the most venerable Marian devotion of the peninsula. This sacral prestige binds clergy and commons to the dynasty and sanctifies the kingdom's rule as no mere law could.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Decades of campaigns from Lepanto to the Catalan Revolt have left thousands of widows, orphans, and crippled veterans of the Tercios de Aragón dependent on parish charity. The Crown will fund a system of Casas de Misericordia and orphanage workshops in Zaragoza, Valencia, and Barcelona, where the children of fallen soldiers receive food, schooling, and apprenticeships under royal patronage. This visible care for soldiers' families restores recruiting enthusiasm in towns that had grown weary of seeing their sons march off and never return.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: The Valencian Fallas — annual neighborhood festivals built around enormous wood-and-papier-mâché monuments burned with fireworks on the feast of Saint Joseph — have produced an entire artisan class skilled in the handling of black powder, fuse mixing, and pyrotechnic timing. The same workshops that fabricate spectacular Saint Joseph crowns now produce ranging tables, fuze-set artillery shells, and the explosive bouquet rounds adopted by the royal arsenal. This festival-born expertise gives the Crown of Aragon a homegrown gunpowder-engineering tradition that mid-sized European powers must purchase from German or French specialists.

Zaragoza and the towns of the Ebro corridor fill with sugar refineries, flour mills, foundries, and rail workshops as the inland kingdom enters the industrial age. The Imperial Canal's water, the new lines linking the city to the Cantabrian coast and the Mediterranean, and a steady migration off the land feed a growing manufacturing economy. This industrial awakening lifts the once-agrarian heartland into a producing region rivaling the old coastal centers.

items.name: Armenia
items.desc: The … people are an ancient civilization, with a history beginning before even the time of the Romans. We have endured the rise and fall of conquering empires without losing either our mother tongue or our faith. Now we shall reunite the scattered heirs of Hayk under one banner and one Armenian identity!

adv.d: Our fortresses are a brilliant emblem of our resilience and fortitude, built to endure not only the difficult local climate, but also any foreign invader foolish enough to mount an attack into our unforgiving territory.

items.name: Austria
items.desc: From Wien, the house of Habsburg once held absolute power in the …, and the very core of that power was the Archduchy of Austria. Now that empire has long since turned to ash, and the time has come for us to reclaim the Archduchy and the seat of Imperial power!

adv.d: Our rise to power has made us the target of much envy, and the rival houses of the Holy Roman Empire vie for our position as the protectors of the south-eastern border. Despite these circumstances, we pride ourselves on executing diplomatic maneuvers unrivaled by any others.

The victory of Rudolf I over his rivals secured our place among the great houses of the Holy Roman Empire and is the subject of many tales and songs. The fervor displayed by him and his knights in the Battle on the Marchfeld will inspire our troops for centuries to come.
'Let others wage war; you, happy Austria, marry! For what Mars gives to others, Venus gives to you — kingdoms.'

c.t: Is or was the country Tyrol (TIR)
Is or was the country Austria (HAB)

adv.d: Our lands are at risk of invasion from hostile neighbors, who desire the riches of our valleys. Creating and funding an order of knights, ready to defend our lands, allows us to draw on greater forces if the need ever arises.
Our people are highly adapted to traverse the obstacles of our country, from the high peaks and passes of our mountains to the wide rivers of our valleys.

Given our location at the center of all Europe, we must adopt a highly flexible attitude towards external diplomacy. Alliances and rivals can shatter as easily as they are formed, and our diplomats must be trained to cover every possible position.
Only well-rounded tactics of artillery shock, cavalry charges, and unyielding infantry recruited from the landknechte can lead us to victory.

Maintaining our diplomatic relations requires time and effort, and committing too many people to diplomatic missions could negatively affect our efficiency and damage our reputation. The Austrian Court's streamlined approach ensures we deploy the right envoys at the right times and still gather the information we need without overextending our diplomatic resources.
A bit of bookkeeping will help us to weather any religious strife that could befall our realm. This harmless edict will surely not spark any further conflict.
The Geheimer Rat is an elite advisory body composed of high-ranking nobles and officials, serving as the central institution for guiding our political, military, and administrative decisions.
Our war council can only function with a proper bureaucratic structure. Only when we know every detail about our troops and logistics can we defend our realm from hostile intruders.

Defending our frontiers is a serious issue, and puts significant financial pressure on the state. The solution we have hit upon is to make generous grants of frontier lands in order to build up a professional military class. This will ensure more discipline overall and facilitate migration to the underpopulated regions of our realm.
Our rulers must receive the best education possible to live up to the ideal of the enlightened monarch.

Recruited from our Carpathian and Balkan lands, these light troops are well equipped to guard the peace in our border regions. Their knowledge of their homeland will make them a formidable opponent for any invader.
Stationed in border garrisons, these regiments of hussars will be able to patrol and secure the far reaches of our country, while keeping the strain on our treasury light.
The rapidly changing nature of warfare urges us to modernize our troops and tactics. In order to stay ahead of our foes, we shall make our artillery the pride of the Imperial army.
Austria is a diverse and multicultural realm, committed to embracing and accommodating its numerous ethnic minorities to maintain unity and stability amidst growing nationalist tensions.
Industrial modernization must always be a priority for our administration. Only through modern manufacturing can we compete with our rivals on a global stage.

Viennese Classicism is a transformative force in music. Our best composers' works shall revolutionize Western musical tradition through bold, trend-setting innovation of symphonic, operatic, and chamber arrangements.

items.name: Ayutthaya
items.desc: A major trading hub with extensive foreign connections and a large population, the city of Ayutthaya will serve as a new source of power for the …, from which we can forge a path towards greater glory. As a united people, we will stand proudly against any who seek to breach our borders.

adv.d: Our country has a rich and complex literary tradition, from the epic Lilit poems narrating famous military conflicts, to the Nirat poetry of travels and lost lovers; from folk legend of local heroes to panegyrics praising the feats of our most glorious rulers.

Whether on horseback or atop an elephant, we can boast of an impressive cavalry, usually made up of descendants from the most prestigious families. Their contributions through supporting our infantry are invaluable.

The white elephant symbolizes sacred kingship in Buddhism tradition, and is also the emblem of our ruler. Possessing a white elephant legitimizes our authority, proving to our subjects that we rule with the blessing of the divine.

Rice has been grown in our country for centuries, but the constant flooding of our rivers has always been an issue for its proper cultivation. This new variety of rice, used to growing in flooded conditions, will provide us with a stable source of food even when the rivers overflow.
All freemen subject to phrai service not only serve in war — the Phrai Thaan — but also assist in the construction of public works, at the discretion of local governors.

All males at the age of eighteen are to be registered with the military, and their information passed on to the government bureaucracy. Every male citizen is eligible to be conscripted and made to serve in the army in war, and we will make sure that they do so if needed.

Our society is strictly organized along the Sakdina system. Each person knows their proper place in society and how much wealth and property they are entitled to have. This organization makes it much more efficient to extract taxes from them.

Our country is home to many people from afar, who came here hoping to profit from the richness of our land. Having so many people and goods flowing through our borders is something we derive numerous benefits from.

items.name: Bahmanis
items.desc: For more than a century, we stood as the dominant … power in the south and controlled vast territories across the …, but those splendid ancient cities were left in shambles long ago. Though internal strife and the rampant ambitions of provincial governors eventually split our realm into five successor sultanates, the time has come to restore the glory of the Bahmani people and unite the … under a single, powerful rule.

items.name: Baltic

pot.t: Any primary, accepted or tolerated culture:

items.desc: The vast lands of the Baltic region have long been divided among various tribes and Germanic states, none of which have been able to assert dominance over the others. However, the time has come for a new power to rise from these lands, uniting the diverse peoples of the Baltic under a single banner and identity.

adv.d: Our forests are a vital resource, providing timber for construction and fuel for our fires. We must manage them wisely to ensure their continued abundance.
Our network of forts and castles scattered across the landscape provides a first line of defense against invaders. These strongholds allow us to monitor and control key routes through the Baltic.

items.name: Bavaria
items.desc: The once-lofty Duchy of Bavaria was a bastion of economic and diplomatic power, with its enviable location and gifted population. But despite its bright past, it now lies in pieces, divided and weak. We must reunite its former territories and reclaim the glories of the past if we wish to be more than a mere footnote in history!

adv.d: We have been granted the rulership of Bavaria directly by the Emperor! By embellishing ourselves as the divinely-appointed protectors of Bavaria, we will ensure our legitimacy cannot be questioned.

Our nobles have distinguished themselves as formidable knights in the service of the Holy Roman Empire. We should nurture and scrupulously maintain these troops to ensure the survival of our ducal integrity.

u: Chivalric order: Order of Saint Hubert
adv.d: The Hubertusorden will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.
Our lands are rich in the crops and fresh water required to brew beer, and our people readily enjoy this abundance. Many small breweries could grow into successful businesses, with the right support.

Our lands are frequently crossed by merchants wishing to trade Salt, Silver, and Livestock in the rich lands to our south. We would be foolish not to take advantage of their presence, and therefore will establish bustling trade hubs in our own lands to attract their business.

With our homeland at the feet of the beautiful Alps, we are a destination for artists from all over Europe, who seek inspiration in our incredible landscape. If we were to construct and support the appropriate cultural institutions, we could refine our court into a center of refinement and elegance, one that could rival even the most prestigious powers of Europe.
We once were ruled by Bavaria, unified in culture and allied under a single banner. We must ensure that the new Bavarian state is equally mighty, a home worthy of its strong and proud people.
Establishing a council with the sole duty of advising our ruler during times of conflict will help us develop a more capable fighting force.
We must ensure our people remain united in their faith, and that they will not be divided by heretical thoughts.
Only with a formidable standing army will we have the military might necessary to match our ambitions. With careful focus, we can expand it without having a ruinous impact on our state's finances.
Regiments of seasoned hunters and foresters. These units will be unmatched in forested terrain, able to hinder and harass our enemies if they dare to enter our forests.

No matter if we are answering to an Imperial overlord or cozying up to a potential foreign ally, our diplomats must be prepared for everything. But only if they keep Bavarian interests first and foremost in their efforts will we be able to claim true success in our diplomatic maneuverings.
Our realm needs a new standardized coin to serve as our national unified currency. Establishing a state-owned mint in our capital would ensure our total control over this new coinage.

The excellent quality of our beer has been celebrated for centuries, but for our brews to achieve legendary status, we must ensure their continued prestige and superiority for all time. Several rulers in the past have created regulations and standards for the brewing of this wonderful substance; and we could use this fact as a stamp of our breweries' quality.

items.name: Belgium
items.desc: The southern lands of the Low Countries are home to a people divided along linguistic and religious lines. But if we were to bring these squabbling groups together and have them working towards the goal of self-government, perhaps it would flatten the differences between us. To this end, we desire to declare ourselves a new and independent state.

items.name: Bohemia
items.desc: Ever since the Golden Bull of Sicily was granted to Ottokar I in 1212, the lands of … enjoyed an elevated status within Central …. With our control of the area, we will be able to reestablish the old title and align ourselves with the legacies of the old dynasties of ….

adv.d: Members of our royal dynasties are accustomed to journeys abroad. They have spent much of their upbringing as students of illustrious courts far away from home, in the pursuit of a thorough education in matters of statesmanship.
Our place within the Holy Roman Empire is one of prestige, grandeur, and authority. Few members wield as much soft power as us, due to our capable diplomats and alliance networks.

As part of our efforts to modernize Prague, we will issue grants encouraging prominent figures to relocate their business to the capital while offering privileges to attract skilled and wealthy foreign immigrants. This influx of talent and capital will transform our Prague into a thriving, cosmopolitan metropolis.

During the Hussite Wars, our armies relied on wagon forts called Wagenburg to win battles against superior forces. While we may not always deploy wagons, the principle remains: infantry sharpshooters fighting from prepared defensive positions become our standard doctrine.
There are very few workshops in the known world with the capacity to craft glass and crystal with the same quality and clarity as ours, let alone rival our superior production techniques.

Through the ravages of the Hussite Wars, and in an effort to safeguard our faith and people, we funded many fortified towns. Since then, we have gained great expertise in erecting fortifications and engineering impenetrable defenses.

For years, the standard currency in our country has been the groschen, a coin made of silver and used all throughout the Holy Roman Empire. The discovery of new sources of silver allows us to create another kind of bigger coin, the thaler, also called 'toler' or 'daler', which will become strong and influential enough to dominate all trade and become a new standard.

Through struggle and brotherhood, the adherents of our faith withstand all external conversion pressures. Our unshaken religious roots, stemming from ancient teachings, ring true to the hearts of all those who seek to protect their beliefs and live in peace alongside their fellow Christian faithful.
The nobility will always be rather sensitive about protecting their privileges. It would go far towards winning their loyalty if said privileges were to be guaranteed forever.

items.name: Burgundy
items.desc: Back in the day, the Burgunds came down from Bornholm, settled in these lands, and gave them their name. As their descendants, our honor requires us to recreate that nation and govern these lands until the end of time.

items.name: Castile
items.desc: From the high meseta and the line of frontier castles that gave the kingdom its name, Castile has risen to become the foremost spear of the Christian Reconquista. By uniting the Castilian heartland under a single crown, we shall reaffirm Castile's dominion over the heart of Iberia.

adv.d: Castile takes its very name from the network of castillos — castles, fortresses, and watchtowers — that has crowned every defensible ridge along the Duero, the Tagus, and the Guadiana since the ninth-century repopulation of the Meseta. Strongholds like Burgos, Gormaz, Calatrava, and the dozens of keeps of the Castillos de la Frontera are raised, manned, and maintained by frontier councils (concejos) and the military orders of Santiago and Calatrava under royal charter. This centuries-deep tradition of fortification gives our Crown a fortress-keeping infrastructure that no other Iberian kingdom can sustain at the same scale.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The Camino de Santiago threads west across our realm from the Pyrenees through Burgos, Carrión, and León toward Compostela, carrying a ceaseless stream of pilgrims, friars, and foreign merchants along its hospices and bridges. The towns strung along the road grow fat on the pilgrim trade, their fueros drawing settlers to repopulate the meseta in the road's wake. This great artery of devotion and commerce fills our frontier towns with people and binds the Christian north into a single road of faith.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: In the tradition of Alfonso X the Wise's Estoria de España, the royal chancery has long commissioned official chronicles of each reign, such as the Crónica de Alfonso XI, Pedro López de Ayala's accounts of the Trastámara civil wars, and Hernando del Pulgar's Crónica de los Reyes Católicos. By compiling these into a single dynastic history, we anchor every Castilian king to a continuous Visigothic and Reconquista lineage stretching back to Pelayo of Asturias. This royal historiography gives our dynasty an unbroken legitimacy that no rival house on the peninsula can claim.

The hermandades — sworn brotherhoods of the Castilian towns — band their militias together to police the roads, hunt down bandits, and keep the king's peace where the crown's own officers cannot reach. Armed with crossbow and pike and answerable to their own elected alcaldes, these leagues field a standing rural constabulary that overawes unruly nobles and footpads alike. This brotherhood militia gives the realm a self-funding instrument of order that no purely feudal levy can match.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: Inspired by the Moorish jinete, the Lanzas de Castilla ride lighter than a knightly lance but fight heavier than a skirmisher, closing to break a formation where a true light horseman would only harass and withdraw.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The royal Audiencias and Chancillerías — the high courts seated at Valladolid and later Granada — carry the king's justice into every corner of the realm, hearing appeals that once died in the courts of grasping lords. Their robed oidores, trained in Roman law at Salamanca, bind noble and commoner alike to a single royal jurisdiction. This apparatus of crown justice knits the kingdom together and strips the great houses of the legal independence that breeds revolt.

Columbus's landfall and the Capitulations of Santa Fe have placed the lands and peoples beyond the Ocean Sea under the Crown of Castile. We will charter conquistadors and licensed colonists on the encomienda pattern, granting them rights over indigenous labor in exchange for evangelization and a fifth — the quinto real — of all metals struck from the new soil. This colonial framework gives Castile alone, of all European powers, an institutional template ready to absorb a hemisphere.

The Armada Real musters the galleons and galleys of Cantabria, Andalusia, and Naples into a single royal fleet that escorts the treasure convoys and contests the seas from the Channel to the Levant. Our dockyards at Santander and the arsenals of the south build and refit the great ships, while a corps of trained crews man them through every campaign. This standing royal navy gives the historical Crown a blue-water reach that no breakaway successor could ever assemble.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The Servicio de Millones, first authorized by the Cortes of Castile after the disaster of the Armada, is an indirect excise on the four staples — wine, oil, vinegar, and meat — sold in the kingdom. Renewed every six years under negotiated terms with the eighteen voting cities, it bypasses noble and clerical tax exemptions by being levied on consumption rather than property ownership. This single reform nearly doubles ordinary Crown revenue at the moment of greatest fiscal strain, ideally sustaining the Habsburg war machine into the next century.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The Consejo de Castilla sits at the apex of the realm's government, a council of letrados that drafts the laws, supervises the courts and the treasury, and governs in the king's name when he is abroad or at war. Its committees and corregidores reach down into every city and province, turning royal will into administrative fact. This central council gives the Crown an instrument of governance whose reach and continuity no rival institution can match.

Founded by Juan Manuel Fernández Pacheco, Marquis of Villena, on the model of the Académie française, the Real Academia Española takes as its motto Limpia, fija y da esplendor — to clean, fix, and give splendor to the Castilian tongue. Its first great project, the six-volume Diccionario de Autoridades, sets the standards of orthography, grammar, and usage that will bind together every Castilian writer from Cádiz to Lima. This institution makes our language the most regulated and exportable of the great European vernaculars, an instrument of empire as much as of letters.

The royal arsenals and Reales Fábricas de Armas gather the realm's gunsmiths and founders into crown manufactories that arm the regiments to a single proofed standard. Cannon from the foundries, muskets from the workshops, and powder from the royal mills flow to the garrisons through a state-run ordnance system. This military-industrial backbone keeps the historical Crown's armies equipped at a scale and consistency that no successor state could improvise.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)

adv.d: To break the dependence on foreign manufactures that drains American silver from the kingdom, the Bourbon kings are founding Reales Fábricas — state-owned manufactories producing luxury goods according to mercantilist principles. The Real Fábrica de Tapices of Madrid, the Real Fábrica de Cristales at La Granja, and the woolen manufactories of Guadalajara employ thousands under royal protection, with foreign masters imported to teach Flemish, Bohemian, and English techniques. This industrial program reverses the eighteenth-century trade deficit and seeds the manufacturing base from which a later industrial revolution can emerge.

items.name: Catalonia
items.desc: The Principality of Catalonia, with its ancient liberties and the merchant fleets of Barcelona, has too long lived in the shadow of the Aragonese crown. By gathering the Catalan lands under our own banner, we shall at last become masters of our own destiny.

c.t: Is or was the country Catalonia (CAT)

adv.d: The formal designation of our territory as Principatus Cathaloniae within the Crown of Aragon makes Catalonia not a mere county or appendage, but a sovereign principality with its own laws, currency, and Corts. The Count of Barcelona styles himself Princeps to underline the legal parity of our institutions with those of the Aragonese kingdom proper. This constitutional dignity raises the standing of our court before Christendom and binds our nobility to a project larger than any single comital house.

c.t: Is or was the country Catalonia (CAT)

adv.d: The Generalitat de Catalunya is a new institution emerging from the old Corts, with the Diputació del General established as the standing executive office that collects our realm's general taxes and represents the Corts between sessions. We will channel public revenue through the Generalitat's accounting system, issuing censals and violaris — perpetual and life annuities on Catalan tax revenue — at rates the older Genoese and Florentine houses cannot match for sovereign borrowers. This standing public-finance institution gives our Crown a stable revenue stream and a public debt market that no other peninsular realm can match.

c.t: Is or was the country Catalonia (CAT)

adv.d: The remença ties Catalan peasants to the land through the six Mals Usos — the 'evil customs' that bind serfs to their fiefs until they purchase their own freedom. Under reformed terms negotiated through the Sentence of Guadalupe, peasants gain proprietary rights over their plots while continuing to pay reduced dues, releasing rural labor and capital throughout the Principality. This agrarian settlement establishes a productive yeomanry in Catalonia decades before any other European kingdom resolves the lord-peasant question.

c.t: Is or was the country Catalonia (CAT)

adv.d: The Reapers' War — when the Catalan harvesters of the Corpus de Sang rose against the lodging of Castilian tercios and the violation of our constitutions — proved that our peasantry can muster a fighting force capable of holding the Principality against the largest army in Europe for nearly two decades. The folk song Els Segadors preserves the memory of that mobilization, and every Catalan child learns the verses from the cradle. This deep tradition of peasant-soldiery gives our Crown a manpower reserve that does not depend on professional recruiters or foreign mercenary captains.

c.t: Is or was the country Catalonia (CAT)

adv.d: The memory of our Principat Constitucionalista endures in legal manuscripts, civic statutes, and the patient scholarship of our jurists. Each generation copies the constitutions, debates them in the universities, and quietly extends their principles into municipal practice wherever the enforcers of these decrees do not look. This persistent constitutional memory tempers the centripetal pull of the court and gives every Catalan municipality a vocabulary of self-government that revolts and reforms can later draw upon.

c.t: Is or was the country Catalonia (CAT)

adv.d: Our literary and cultural revival — the Renaixença Catalana — restores Catalan to the printing press, the lecture hall, and the lyric stage after generations in which our language survived only in private correspondence and folk song. We will sponsor the restored Jocs Florals poetic competitions, fund the dictionaries and grammars that codify a modern literary standard, and bring our tongue back into the press, the academy, and the public administration. This cultural rebirth raises literacy among our subjects in their native language and binds every Catalan-speaking community into a single shared culture that no centralizing state can easily absorb.

items.name: Croatia
items.desc: The land of … has been point of encounter between European West and East for centuries, between the waters of the Mediterranean and the many countries of the interior. Having been traversed by many peoples and cultures, it is under the … identity that it will be able to flourish.

adv.d: The cultural soul of Croatia is anchored in the 'Zvonimir tradition', where our history is carved in stone. We have promoted the memory of our independent kings through epic poetry and historical chronicles, instilling a 'Royal Consciousness' in every peasant and noble. This historical pride ensures that even when ruled by foreign kings, the Croatians view themselves as part of an ancient and sovereign nation, fostering a resilience that ensures our culture remains vibrant and resistant to external cultural decay.

This legal bedrock formalized the union between the Twelve Noble Tribes of Croatia and the Hungarian Crown. By preserving the right to elect the monarch and maintaining a separate coronation with the Zvonimir Crown, we ensure Croatia remains a distinct political entity in the case of falling in Union with other nations. This contractual sovereignty prevents total absorption into a foreign administration, allowing our nobility to manage internal justice and defense under their own ancient laws.

We look back to the glorious age of our native kings, such as Tomislav and Zvonimir, to inspire a sense of independent destiny and national pride. By tracing our lineage and institutions back to these sovereign rulers, we bolster our diplomatic standing among the courts of Europe and assert our right to a crown that is older than many of our neighbors'. This historical prestige commands respect from the Holy See and serves as a powerful unifying mythos that rallies the disparate regions of the kingdom under a single, storied banner of Romanic-Slavic royalty.

We have asserted the right of Monetaria, establishing a sovereign mint to produce the Banovac silver denar. By maintaining a higher silver content than neighboring currencies, our coin has become the primary medium of exchange in the northern Adriatic and the Drava basin. This fiscal independence allows us to fund its administration without relying on external subsidies, turning our court into a regional financial hub that attracts Ragusan and Venetian capital.

b: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle: +10%
adv.d: Our cultural identity has been forged in the fire of the 'Century of Martyrs'. We have embraced the role of the Antemurale Christianitatis (Shield of Christendom), transforming our military struggle into a sacred religious mission. This mythos instills a deep, unshakable sense of historical duty in the population, viewing the defense of our nation as the defense of civilization itself. This 'Heroic Spirit' ensures that the national fire remains alive even in our darkest hours.

We have established one of the earliest and most daring printing houses in the Slavic world. By moving our technological heart to the 'impassable' valley of Kosinj, we ensure that the production of our sacred Glagolitic texts remains shielded from the maritime raids and border skirmishes that plague the littoral. This press is not merely a tool for literacy; it is a laboratory of cultural survival where we forge the first printed missals in our native tongue. By standardizing our ancient script through the modern press, we provide every parish in the Kingdom with a unified, incorruptible source of our laws and liturgy. This ensures that the Croatian identity remains intellectually fortified and spiritually independent, as it reaches the hands of every shepherd and noble, anchoring the soul of the nation in an unshakeable, home-grown tradition.

Founded by the invited Jesuit Order, this academy has evolved from a local gymnasium into the intellectual heart of our nation. By establishing a rigorous curriculum of Aristotelian philosophy, mathematics, and rhetoric, the academy has created a home-grown elite of 'Enlightened Croats' who are as comfortable in the salons of Vienna as they are in the Sabor. This institutional modernization ensures that our bureaucracy is led by a technocratic class capable of navigating the complex legal and scientific shifts of our century.

To counter the advance of our enemies, we have transformed our coastal fortresses into a sanctuary for the Uskoks — refugee warriors who wage a permanent war. These light-infantry units use small, fast boats to conduct lightning raids against enemy supply lines, surviving in the rugged karst where regular armies cannot follow. This policy turns our coast into a lethal 'no-man's-land' for our enemies, providing us with a cheap and fiercely motivated frontier guard that requires no support from the central treasury and keeps our enemies constantly on the defensive.

Our culture has embraced a dramatic and intense Baroque Catholicism, characterized by massive religious processions and the construction of grand, ornate churches. This 'Visual Piety' serves as a powerful unifying force, bridging the gap between the urban nobility and the rural peasantry through shared ritual and spectacle. This intense religious identity acts as a cultural shield against both Protestant and Eastern influences, ensuring that the Croatian soul remains firmly anchored in the Catholic-Mediterranean world, even while defending the central European plains.

To combat the sudden amphibious raids of enemy fleets or border transgressions, we will establish a sophisticated visual system using smoke and fire signals atop the highest Velebit crags. This 'Mountain Watch' will allow our forts to communicate across the jagged terrain in minutes, bypassing the slow mountain trails. By coordinating these signals with the inland garrisons, we will be able to mobilize our nation and reinforce our walls before any action happens. This high-altitude surveillance will turn the impassable peaks into a centralized command tower, ensuring that no enemy can approach without our immediate knowledge.

We have established the Consilium Regium in our capital, creating a dedicated executive government for the Croatian Nation. This body will act as a proto-ministry, handling the economy, education, and internal security of the Triune Kingdom. This era of 'Government by Council' will foster a professional class of Croatian civil servants who view the state as a rational, modern machine rather than a collection of feudal privileges. The experience gained in these halls of power will provide the administrative expertise necessary for the Croatian people to navigate the transition from a medieval kingdom to a modern European nation-state.

adv.n: Uniting the Coast and the Inner Lands
adv.d: To break the isolation of our coast, we will oversee the monumental construction of numerous roads, linking the inland to our ports. This engineered highway will be carved through the limestone heart of the Velebit mountains, featuring advanced stone bridges and serpentine curves to accommodate heavy wagons. The road will transform our littoral from a desolate frontier into a vital economic artery, allowing the timber and grain of the interior to reach international markets. By physically binding the mountain hinterland to the Adriatic, we will complete the territorial integration of the nation, fostering a new age of trans-Velebit commerce.

items.name: Dahomey
items.desc: We have consolidated our territories and will now be able to establish a new country to resist foreign influences.

adv.d: Our ancient legends state that our royal line is descended from the union of a princess and a panther. This ancient and mystical tale will enhance our prestige and fame.
The Migan and the Mehu are the ruler's two chief ministers. One oversees the north, the other the south; one oversees justice, the other commerce. Together, they bring stability and prosperity.

A corp of female warriors, recruited from among the king's wives. They have earned their reputation as mythological Amazons due to their ferocity in battle and the fear they strike in the ranks of their opponents. These Dahomey Amazons are entirely devoted to Dahomey and its interests.
By secretly placing male courtiers disguised as royal wives in the harem, they will be able to act unseen as the king's eyes and ears, especially in matters of palace intrigue.

While raiding the surrounding territories, we obtain slaves who cannot only be employed economically or bartered to our neighbors, but who can serve in our armies. In this way, we will increase the number of fighters that can be called to arms.
As more and more foreigners are coming to our shores, we should establish a new office in our government to study and learn from their ways, so that we may benefit from this exchange of cultures.

Building a sprawling palace complex in our capital would be an elegant, yet imposing demonstration of our power. Any who may consider taking up arms against us will surely be deterred by the sight of our sumptuous palaces.

items.name: Dalriada

items.desc: The … peoples on the coasts around the … first united long ago, forming a kingdom famous for its seafaring culture and the strength of its fleet. We must claim this ancestral legacy and revive the kingdom.

items.name: Denmark
items.desc: Denmark, situated between the North Sea and Baltic Sea, is a country with great significance for …. If we can control enough of its territory, we could reform it, and restore the legacy birthed by our forebears.

adv.d: Every part of our country is surrounded by the waters of the Baltic and North Seas. This gives us the unique advantage of being able to utilize waterways for both transport and communication, considerably shortening the time it takes to travel between regions.

Our domain is protected by natural barriers, namely the Jutland Peninsula and the Danish archipelago. This defensive geography is extremely helpful when we are under attack, as it gives us time to raise levies before our enemies can reach our core territory.

Denmark cannot rely on a vast population to supply their armies. Therefore, we need to ensure that mercenary companies are willing to serve our state, while guaranteeing their loyalty with solid contracts.

The rulers of Denmark have claimed overlordship over the Nordic regions for centuries. Embellishing the legacy of Kings like Canute 'the Great' will grant us the internal and external legitimacy needed to support our assertions.

Our country is surrounded by water, and therefore vulnerable to domination by any power with a large enough fleet. To ensure this will never happen, we must fund a navy capable of protecting our coastline and projecting our power over the north of Europe.

By establishing a separate department for our Treasury, the Rentekammeret, we will have better control over our finances and be able to run the government more efficiently. With the documentation of all our financial records, we will be able to estimate our future expenditures more easily, stabilizing our finances.
In the tumultuous religious landscape of Europe, we must set Denmark on the path to righteousness, and remain true to the doctrines of our church.

Our country has a long and proud history of shipbuilding. Our experienced shipwrights need a modern and spacious dock in which to construct a navy worthy of calling itself Danish. The waters around Copenhagen are the perfect place to construct such a dockyard.

While the Danish terrain is relatively poor in terms of rare materials available to exploit, they make up for it with agricultural abundance. We shall focus on optimizing our farming and food production, safeguarding our people against future periods of famine.

The regional laws of Jutland, Zealand and Scania formed the basis of our legal code for centuries. For the benefit of our realm, we should compile and unify these laws into a single comprehensive legal system, which will be known as the Danske Lov.
The Royal Life Guards are an elite Danish regiment that also serve as the ruler's personal guard and perform ceremonial duties.
The Scanian Regiment is a military unit composed of drafted peasants, established to reduce reliance on mercenary forces and build a more organized standing army under direct royal authority.

We cannot produce everything we need to maintain economic stability on our own. We must instead rely on a stable trade network to export our goods and import everything that we ourselves are not able to produce.

With the establishment of a centralized college to train our naval commanders, we will be able to produce skilled leaders familiar with our coastal waters. This will improve our marine defense strategy, and ultimately better safeguard Danish sovereignty.

items.name: England
items.desc: Trade has long been a foundation of English national policy. By extending our influence across borders and controlling its political development domestically, we have managed to become a major European power. Our colonial expansion is becoming a major factor in promoting our nation's economic growth, reinforcing our position in world affairs.

adv.d: The bravery and discipline of English foot soldiers has been witnessed from the shieldwalls of Northumbria to the darkened skies of France. Inspired by the lion-hearted spirit of our kings and the stoicism of the common man, our infantry fights with the ferocity of the Anglo-Saxon warriors before them.

The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the …. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.

Our island protects us from outside enemies, but that will not matter if we do not protect the surrounding waters. By being true masters of our surrounding seas, we will keep a firm control on those who threaten our land.

adv.d: The powerful martial longbow, originally deployed with great impact against armored English knights in the Welsh valleys, has been adopted into the military doctrine on either side of the border.

adv.d: The Longbowmen excel not only due to their powerful warbow but also their years of training on the archery fields.

Beginning around 1495, the Tudor monarchy invested heavily in not just ships, but extensive infrastructure to maintain and otherwise support them. This for many marked the official founding of the Royal Navy.

adv.d: Small innovations in equipment and organization result in continuous devastating volleys that shatter all but the most heavily armored formations.

The monarch has always had a secretary responsible for their royal correspondence. This position eventually evolved into that of the Secretary of State, a powerful minister who not only transmits royal decrees, but also has a high level of administrative authority.

The Eltham Ordinances represented England's first attempt to streamline royal bureaucracy and make it more adaptable and cost-effective. The Ordinances attempted reform through reducing royal household expenditures and consolidating certain bureaucratic functions.

Robert Blake has written several sets of rules and regulations that resulted in sweeping naval reforms. These include new tactics for blockades and landings, as well as adoption of the single line ahead battle formation.

The invention of coke smelting, specifically its application in Iron and Steel production, is closely tied to the Industrial Revolution. Iron and Steel are currently produced using traditional methods like charcoal smelting, whereas this new method will result in improved output and reduced maintenance costs.

A sweeping series of reforms limiting royal power, particularly in judicial matters. Among other stipulations, they state that the monarch may not unilaterally raise armies, prescribe cruel and unusual punishment, or interfere with the free election of members of Parliament.

The architectural innovations made by Inigo Jones will undoubtedly have a significant impact on future generations of architects. His promotion of classical architecture and his priority on proportion and harmony are considered hallmarks of the neoclassical movement in England.
These acts represent the apex of mercantilism. Trade must be conducted with our ships and pass through our ports first, where we will collect customs duties and any other applicable taxes.
This institution looked after the welfare of ordinary enlisted seamen in the Navy. It brought about a series of reforms that greatly improved the health of sailors on duty.

Elite marksmen equipped with the long-range Baker Rifle and trained to screen the main force in small independent pickets, Experimental Riflemen represent a modern vision of infantry combat formations.

Life in the English army is grueling and strictly regimented, but it instills in one a certain character. The unflappable nature of our troops, as well as their expertise with firearms, strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies.
A massive sea presence is required for any nation attempting to rule the waters. Our fleet will be so imposing that the shores of our enemies will always be surrounded by our vessels.
The water frame is a spinning frame used in the textile industry to produce cotton thread. This innovation will contribute to the establishment of large textile factories powered by water wheels.

items.name: Franconia
items.desc: Once the seat of a powerful stem duchy, … has declined over the centuries, and the associated title of Duke of … has become nominal and irrelevant. But if we re-established our authority and were able to solidify control over the old duchy, we could finally resurrect the Franconia and restore its tarnished former splendor.

adv.d: The Gesellschaft mit dem Fürspang is an order of knights formed to defend their interests and provide assistance to those who sponsor them. Providing them with extensive funds will grant us significantly more political prowess within our region and within the Holy Roman Empire.

items.name: Galicia
items.desc: Long before the rise of León or Castile, the Galician kingdom of the Suevi held the green hills of the northwest. By restoring this ancient realm in our own tongue, we shall revive a Galician crown free from foreign tutelage.

c.t: Is or was the country Galicia (GLC)

adv.d: Our brief independent kingdom under King García from 1065, severed by his father's testament from León and Portugal, demonstrated that the Galician court could function as a sovereign realm with its own coinage, charters, and military levy. Though García was deposed and imprisoned by his brothers in 1071, the memory of his Regnum Gallaeciae lingered in noble pretensions and ecclesiastical claims across the centuries. This recovered royal legacy lets us govern our outlying territories with a confidence that recently-independent realms cannot project.

c.t: Is or was the country Galicia (GLC)

adv.d: Our Cathedral of Santiago houses the relics of Saint James the Apostle and stands as one of the three premier pilgrimage destinations of Latin Christendom alongside Rome and Jerusalem. The Pórtico de la Gloria and the great processional liturgies bring princes, prelates, and ambassadors to our doors year after year, every visit an opportunity for diplomatic exchange we did not have to negotiate. This institutional gravity makes our court a regular interlocutor for Catholic powers across Europe and reduces the cost of our diplomatic correspondence.

c.t: Is or was the country Galicia (GLC)

adv.d: As our Monarchs build their great Atlantic armada, our Galician squadron contributes the bulk of the experienced sailors, navigators, and galleon hulls that anchor the formation. The Armada de Galicia musters at Ferrol and Vigo, drawing on every coastal village for crew and on the granite-laden Galician hills for ship timber and stone ballast. This naval-amphibious infrastructure gives our Crown the capability to project soldiers across the Atlantic that few other regional powers can match.

c.t: Is or was the country Galicia (GLC)

adv.d: Repeated English and Barbary raids on our coast force us to invest in great defensive walls and bastions at A Coruña, Bayona, and Vigo — the Murallas Atlánticas that protect our ports from the gunpowder-armed raids of the seventeenth century. Each fortress is maintained by the towns it protects through dedicated revenues, with the crown contributing engineering expertise and artillery. This network of barriers makes our Atlantic coastline disproportionately expensive to assault and frees field armies for operations elsewhere.

adv.n: Junta General del Reino de Galicia

c.t: Is or was the country Galicia (GLC)

adv.d: Our Junta General del Reino de Galicia convenes the seven episcopal seats of Galicia — Santiago, Ourense, Lugo, Mondoñedo, Betanzos, A Coruña, and Tui — to deliberate on taxation, justice, and the defense of the kingdom under the Crown's framework. The Junta's decisions carry the weight of consensus across the entire region and bind even the powerful Galician nobility to provincial decisions they did not individually agree to. This collective institutional voice gives our Crown a partner for governing the kingdom's interior that purely bureaucratic provinces lack.

c.t: Is or was the country Galicia (GLC)

adv.d: Our Atlantic Squadron based at the Royal Arsenal of Ferrol has become the backbone of Iberian naval power in the modern era — a permanent force of battleships, cruisers, and destroyer divisions ready to defend Iberian waters and project force across both Americas. The Escuadra Atlántica drills year-round in the protected estuaries of the Galician coast, maintaining a level of operational readiness that more dispersed fleets cannot match. This concentrated naval doctrine lets our navy intervene faster and with more coordinated firepower than any peer-power Atlantic force.

items.name: Galicia-Lodomeria
items.desc: We have gained possession of vast territories in Poland. Rather than impose direct rule over this diverse region, we shall establish the Galicia-Lodomeria as a crown land, allowing us to govern through traditional titles while maintaining imperial control.

items.name: Georgia
items.desc: The very landscape of … and the ravages of foreign incursion have repeatedly tested our people's resilience, but we have triumphed, proving ourselves as tough as the mountains and highlands that protect us. With grit and determination, we shall see Georgia rise once again and flourish under our leadership.

adv.d: A dynasty so old that its origins are shrouded in mystery, kings and queens of the Bagrationi house have ruled Georgia ever since the 9th century, first as its princes and then as monarchs.

Our association with the legendary Saint George is well known through both the Christian and Muslim worlds. As he bravely faced and slew the fearsome dragon, so will our soldiers face our enemies in battle.

Considered the greatest ruler in the history of our country, King Davit the Builder brought Georgia to its pinnacle. He built a powerful, culturally influential kingdom, and a beacon for Christianity and the Georgian people.

Georgia enjoyed a cultural and religious Golden Age that was brought to a sudden stop, due to the Mongol invasions. That period witnessed the peak of our cultural achievements, but we will now return to it, and achieve even greater heights.
Tamar was one of the greatest rulers our nation ever had. Her military and cultural successes are legendary, and the mere utterance of her name still stirs reverence in all Georgian hearts.

'King of Kings, strong and invincible, majestic and protector of the holy kingdom of the Abkhazians, Iberians, Ranis, Kakhetians, Armenians, Shahanshah and Shirvanshah, of the East and the West, of the South and the North, of both countries, of two thrones and crowns, the godlike Suzerain and the Sovereign of the Throne.' The titles of our ruler are numerous, and all at court shall respect them!

Georgia has been a haven for Christianity in the Caucasus for centuries, even after being surrounded and isolated by followers of Islam. The ardent faith of our people is a source of inspiration for all our religious brethren.

Our country has a rich tradition of minting coins, inscribing them not only in Georgian but also in Arabic and Persian, as they serve as currency for trade through our country and those that neighbor us.
Our regional administration is divided into many different principalities and territories. Delegating authority this way allows us to exert our rule more effectively.

Our country has been torn apart, by external and internal influences, more than once in its long history. However, like the phoenix of legend, it has risen from the ashes and established itself as a presence to reckon with each time. The resilience of our people is commendable.

items.name: Greece
items.desc: Since the earliest days of our civilization, Hellas has been divided, whether internally by its many competing kingdoms, or occupied by foreigners at the hands of our common enemies. Over the centuries, our power dwindled as we were conquered, split up, and our treasures taken by conquerors. It is an insult to our extensive legacy of art, sport, and invention to exist in such a fragmented state! To unite the Greek lands under one flag and one ruler is our only path back to the greatness of our past.

adv.d: To survive the chaos of the Fourth Crusade, the scattered Greek fragments must return to the principle of a single, absolute Basileus. We have dismantled the local Archon rivalries that allowed the Latins to conquer us piecemeal, re-establishing a central court that commands absolute loyalty. This centralization of power ensures that the state speaks with one voice and acts with one sword, suppressing the internal bickering that once bled the Empire dry.

We have looked to the golden age of the Middle Byzantine period to solve our manpower crisis. By granting hereditary land plots to Akritai (border guards) in exchange for perpetual military service, we create a self-sustaining defense force deeply rooted in the soil they protect. This system reduces our reliance on expensive mercenaries and ensures that every province has a dedicated militia capable of holding the line until the main imperial army arrives.

We have revolutionized the agriculture of Greece, moving away from subsistence farming toward high-value export crops, specifically the famous Malvasia wine and sun-dried currants. By investing in modern irrigation and processing techniques, we have made our agricultural products a staple of the European luxury market. The resulting economic boom funds a professional standing army and allows us to maintain a courtly splendor that rivals the great kings of the West.

As gunpowder reshapes the battlefields of Europe, we have synthesized Western musket drills with our traditional tactical manuals. Our infantry, the New Stratikon, are trained to maintain rigid discipline under fire, mimicking the legendary resilience of the ancient phalanx but armed with modern harquebuses and pikes. This professionalization of the rank-and-file ensures that we are no longer a medieval relic, but a modern military powerhouse capable of standing toe-to-toe with any empire.

A unified Greece must be the master of the 'Inner Sea' if it is to survive between the giants of East and West. We have established a centralized Admiralty in Piraeus, standardizing ship construction and training a professional officer corps in the latest navigational sciences. By merging the speed of the galley with the firepower of the galleon, we create a fleet that is both agile in the Aegean winds and formidable in the open Mediterranean.

The dream of a restored Hellenic world, stretching from the Ionian to the Anatolian coast, has become the guiding star of our national policy. We have developed a legal and historical framework that justifies our expansion into all lands once held by our ancestors, framing our conquests as 'liberations'. This ideological fervor drives our administration to integrate new territories with unprecedented speed, as the populace welcomes their return to the Hellenic fold.

items.name: Hanover
items.desc: With the majority of … under our control, and … secured, we will be able to proclaim ourselves as a new country, a beacon of strength to lead our people into the future! With determination and cunning, we shall establish ourselves as a decisive power within ….

items.name: Hausa
items.desc: After decades of feuds and wars shattering our land, the old rivalries have finally been quashed, and peace realized. For the first time in living memory, the sons of Bawo are again reunited under the same banner. It is time for the Hausa to rise as one again!

items.name: Holstein
items.desc: After many years of being controlled by one noble family or another, we have finally established ourselves as the supreme rulers of …. It is our right to reform our territorial possessions into one country, and therefore we shall.

items.name: Imerina
items.desc: Ours is an island of many influences, a conflux of cultures that has created unique syncretic beliefs and ways of life. Although this mixture of differences is part of what makes us great, we should promote the idea of our being a unified people despite these distinctions. A unified Malagasy state under our leadership will allow our island to prosper and ensure stability — and increased power — for our people.

items.desc: For decades, England has attempted to subjugate the Irish population and control the island and its inhabitants from afar. Uniting Irish lands under a single flag and purpose may be our only chance to repel these merciless conquerors!

adv.d: County grand juries levy the cess for roads, bridges, and courthouses. With judges riding the assizes, oversight tightens in every county.

A permanent army in Ireland — and controlled from Ireland — keeps garrisons ready and costs down. For our regular soldiery, this means regular pay. For our logisticians and quartermasters, it means a growing network of barracks that keeps the costs in hand.
Citizen corps are raised for home defense and coastal watch. Drilling at their own expense, they rouse public spirit and stiffen the line.
